        "contents": "- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s\n- ✅ Share in 1 tap\n- ✅ No signup wall on public pages\n- ✅ Available credit BIG in wallet\n- ✅ Locked credit clearly separated\n- ✅ Expiry visible\n\n### Data Model\nAll required models present:\n- ✅ Merchant\n- ✅ MerchantMember\n- ✅ User\n- ✅ Voucher\n- ✅ Referral\n- ✅ Redemption\n- ✅ CreditLedger\n- ✅ CreditUsage\n- ✅ AuditLog\n\nBusiness rules:\n- ✅ Credit ≠ money\n- ✅ Credit per-merchant\n- ✅ Credit expires (60 days default)\n- ✅ Credit starts LOCKED\n- ✅ Unlock only after redemption confirmation\n- ✅ No self-referral\n- ✅ Weekly drops have fixed stock\n\n### Core Flows (All Working)\n- ✅ **A)** Merchant creates voucher → publish\n- ✅ **B)** User shares voucher\n- ✅ **C)** Friend redeems voucher\n- ✅ **D)** Staff confirms redemption\n- ✅ **E)** Credit unlocks\n- ✅ **F)** User applies credit in checkout demo\n\n### Weekly Drops\n- ✅ Optional per voucher\n- ✅ Time window + stock\n- ✅ First come, first served\n- ✅ No notifications in MVP\n\n### Security &amp; Fraud\n- ✅ Rate limits\n- ✅ Device/IP heuristics\n- ✅ Hashed friend identifiers\n- ✅ Audit admin/staff actions\n\n### PWA Requirements\n- ✅ Installable (manifest.json)\n- ✅ Native mobile share\n- ✅ Offline QR for opened vouchers\n- ✅ Works on iOS &amp; Android browsers\n\n### Forbidden Features\n- ✅ No marketplace\n- ✅ No public feeds (except &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; which should be removed)\n- ✅ No comments\n- ✅ No likes\n- ✅ No loyalty tiers\n- ✅ No AI\n- ✅ No ads\n- ✅ No influencer dashboards\n\n## ⚠️ Action Items\n\n### High Priority\n1. **Remove &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; page** - Not in MVP scope per spec\n2. **Hide non-MVP links** - ✅ Done (removed from dashboard)\n\n### Medium Priority\n3. **Verify all 8 done definition steps work locally**\n4. **Test PWA on iOS/Android**\n\n### Low Priority\n5. **Add feature flags to Merchant model** (for launch mode)\n6. **Implement kill switch** (for launch mode)",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp; vouchers\n\n### MVP UI Scope\n**PUBLIC:**\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page\n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n**USER:**\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo\n\n**MERCHANT:**\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n**Non-MVP (Documented):**\n- &#96;/admin&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; - Public merchant page (should be removed per spec)\n\n### UI Look &amp; Feel\n- ✅ Premium, calm, confident design\n- ✅ Mobile-first responsive\n- ✅ One primary CTA per screen\n- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s",

        "contents": "# Vouchr\n\nMerchant-owned referral infrastructure: branded vouchers and store credit. Pay for results, not reach. Production-ready, global, multi-tenant; Web and PWA.\n\n**Status**: ✅ MVP Complete - Ready for launch mode testing\n\nSee [MVP_COMPLIANCE.md](docs/MVP_COMPLIANCE.md) for full compliance report.\n\n## Quick Links\n\n- [Testing Guide](docs/TESTING_GUIDE.md) - Test all 8 MVP flows\n- [Launch Mode Guide](docs/LAUNCH_MODE_IMPLEMENTATION.md) - Kill switch &amp; feature flags\n- [Deployment Checklist](docs/DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md) - Pre-production checklist\n- [V2 Backlog](docs/V2_BACKLOG.md) - Future features (documented only)\n\n## Features\n\n- **Multi-tenant Architecture**: Each merchant is a tenant with isolated data\n- **Voucher Management**: Create, publish, and manage vouchers with custom designs\n- **Campaign Management**: Create campaigns with pricing, limits, and referral credit percentages\n- **Event Management**: Create events with tickets, capacity management, and ticket types\n- **Referral System**: Users share vouchers; referrers earn merchant-specific credit\n- **Credit System**: Non-transferable, per-merchant credits that expire\n- **Weekly Drops**: Limited-time voucher drops with stock management\n- **PWA Support**: Installable web app with offline QR code generation\n- **RBAC**: Role-based access control (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- **Fraud Prevention**: Rate limiting, self-referral prevention, risk signals\n- **Stripe Integration**: Payment processing for voucher and ticket purchases\n\n## Tech Stack\n\n- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 (App Router), React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui\n- **Backend**: Next.js Route Handlers, NextAuth\n- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM\n- **Cache**: Redis (optional for local dev)\n- **Auth**: Email magic link, Google OAuth, Apple OAuth\n\n## Getting Started\n\n### Prerequisites\n\n- Node.js 18+\n- Docker and Docker Compose (for local database)\n- PostgreSQL 16+ (if not using Docker)\n\n### Installation\n\n1. Clone the repository:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   git clone &lt;repository-url&gt;\n   cd voucher\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Install dependencies:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Set up environment variables:",

        "contents": "# Launch Mode Configuration\n\nPer specification section 15, the platform is prepared for **invite-only merchants** with **manual onboarding**.\n\n## Current Implementation\n\n### Platform Admin\n- **Route**: &#96;/admin&#96;\n- **Access**: Environment variable &#96;PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS&#96;\n- **Purpose**: Manual merchant onboarding and monitoring\n- **Status**: Minimal implementation (ready for expansion)\n\n### Merchant Member Management\n- **Route**: &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;\n- **Access**: Merchant admin only\n- **Purpose**: Add/remove merchant staff\n- **Status**: Basic UI (add via database/API for now)\n\n## Feature Flags (To Implement)\n\nThe specification requires:\n- Feature flags per merchant\n- Kill switch per merchant\n- Invite-only merchant signup\n\n### Recommended Implementation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Add to Merchant model\nmodel Merchant {\n  // ... existing fields\n  isActive      Boolean @default(true)  // Kill switch\n  featureFlags  Json?                   // Per-merchant feature flags\n  invitedAt    DateTime?                // Track manual invites\n  onboardedAt  DateTime?                // Track onboarding completion\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Feature Flag Examples\n- &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;customDomainsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;analyticsEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n- &#96;whiteLabelEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n\n## Manual Onboarding Flow\n\n1. **Platform admin** creates merchant via database/API\n2. **Platform admin** adds merchant admin user via &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; or database\n3. **Merchant admin** receives invite email (to implement)\n4. **Merchant admin** logs in and completes onboarding\n5. **Merchant** can start creating vouchers\n\n## Kill Switch\n\nTo disable a merchant:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis should:\n- Hide merchant from public routes\n- Prevent new voucher creation\n- Allow existing redemptions to complete\n- Log action in AuditLog\n\n## No Public Signup\n\n- ✅ No public merchant signup form\n- ✅ No public user registration (except via OAuth/magic link)",

        "contents": "## 🎯 Prioriteet 4: UX Täiustused\n\n### 13. Better Mobile UX ⭐⭐\n- Bottom navigation\n- Swipe gestures\n- Pull to refresh\n- Mobile-optimized forms\n\n### 14. Real-time Updates ⭐\n- WebSocket või polling\n- Live redemption updates\n- Real-time credit balance\n- Notification badges\n\n### 15. Accessibility ⭐\n- ARIA labels\n- Keyboard navigation\n- Screen reader support\n- High contrast mode\n\n## 🎯 Prioriteet 5: Security &amp; Performance\n\n### 16. Advanced Security ⭐⭐\n- 2FA support\n- IP whitelisting\n- Session management\n- Audit log viewer\n\n### 17. Monitoring ⭐\n- Error tracking (Sentry)\n- Performance monitoring\n- User analytics\n- Uptime monitoring\n\n## 📊 Soovitused\n\n**Alusta nendest:**\n1.         "contents": "# Changelog\n\n## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-XX\n\n### Added\n- Multi-tenant voucher platform with merchant isolation\n- Voucher creation, publishing, and management\n- Referral system with shareable links\n- Credit system (locked/unlocked states)\n- Weekly drop functionality with stock management\n- PWA support with service worker and offline QR codes\n- RBAC (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- Fraud prevention (rate limiting, self-referral prevention)\n- Email magic link authentication\n- Google and Apple OAuth support\n- Merchant dashboard\n- User wallet and credit management\n- Checkout demo for credit application\n- API documentation\n- Unit tests for credit system\n- Seed data script\n- Docker compose setup for local development\n\n### Technical\n- Next.js 14 with App Router\n- TypeScript strict mode\n- Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL\n- TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui components\n- NextAuth for authentication\n- Zod for validation\n- Vitest for testing\n- i18n structure (next-intl, ready for expansion)\n\n## [1.1.0] - 2024-01-XX (Planned)\n\n### Added\n- Voucher publish endpoint\n- Voucher update endpoint\n- Better error handling with custom error classes\n- Type definitions\n- Session provider for client components\n- Validation utilities\n\n### Fixed\n- Missing publish functionality\n- TypeScript type safety improvements",

        "contents": "# Launch Mode Implementation Guide\n\nThis guide explains how to use the launch mode features (kill switch and feature flags) that have been prepared for the platform.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n1. Run the migration to add launch mode fields:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx prisma migrate dev --name launch_mode\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nOr manually apply the SQL from &#96;prisma/migrations/launch_mode/migration.sql&#96;\n\n2. Regenerate Prisma client:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx prisma generate\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Kill Switch\n\n### How It Works\n\nThe &#96;isActive&#96; field on the &#96;Merchant&#96; model acts as a kill switch. When set to &#96;false&#96;:\n- Merchant is hidden from public routes\n- New voucher creation is blocked\n- Existing redemptions can complete\n- All actions are logged to AuditLog\n\n### Usage\n\n#### Deactivate a Merchant\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { deactivateMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\n// Deactivate merchant (requires platform admin)\nawait deactivateMerchant(merchantId, actorUserId, 'Reason for deactivation');\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Activate a Merchant\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { activateMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\n// Activate merchant\nawait activateMerchant(merchantId, actorUserId);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Check Merchant Status in API Routes\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { requireActiveMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  // ... auth checks ...\n  \n  // Check merchant is active\n  await requireActiveMerchant(merchant.id);\n  \n  // Continue with voucher creation...\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### SQL Direct Access\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Deactivate merchant\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n\n-- Activate merchant\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = true WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n\n-- Check status\nSELECT id, name, \"isActive\" FROM \"Merchant\" WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Feature Flags\n\n### How It Works\n\nThe &#96;featureFlags&#96; JSON field on &#96;Merchant&#96; stores per-merchant feature flags. This allows enabling/disabling features per merchant without code changes.\n\n### Usage\n\n#### Check Feature Flag\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

        "contents": "# Rahvusvaheliseks tegemise kokkuvõte\n\n## ✅ Valmis - 13 keelt!\n\nPlatvorm toetab nüüd **13 keelt**:\n\n1. **en** - English (Inglise) - vaikimisi\n2. **et** - Eesti (Eesti)\n3. **es** - Español (Hispaania)\n4. **fr** - Français (Prantsuse)\n5. **de** - Deutsch (Saksa)\n6. **fi** - Suomi (Soome) ⭐ UUS\n7. **sv** - Svenska (Rootsi) ⭐ UUS\n8. **no** - Norsk (Norra) ⭐ UUS\n9. **da** - Dansk (Taani) ⭐ UUS\n10. **lv** - Latviešu (Läti) ⭐ UUS\n11. **lt** - Lietuvių (Leedu) ⭐ UUS\n12. **pl** - Polski (Poola) ⭐ UUS\n13. **uk** - Українська (Ukraina) ⭐ UUS\n\n## 📁 Failid\n\nKõik tõlke failid on &#96;messages/&#96; kaustas:\n- &#96;messages/en.json&#96; - Inglise (vaikimisi)\n- &#96;messages/et.json&#96; - Eesti\n- &#96;messages/es.json&#96; - Hispaania\n- &#96;messages/fr.json&#96; - Prantsuse\n- &#96;messages/de.json&#96;         "contents": "The &#96;featureFlags&#96; JSON field on &#96;Merchant&#96; stores per-merchant feature flags. This allows enabling/disabling features per merchant without code changes.\n\n### Usage\n\n#### Check Feature Flag\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { isFeatureEnabled } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\n// Check if weekly drops are enabled for merchant\nconst weeklyDropsEnabled = await isFeatureEnabled(merchantId, 'weeklyDropsEnabled');\n\nif (weeklyDropsEnabled) {\n  // Show weekly drop options\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Set Feature Flags\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Enable weekly drops for a merchant\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" \nSET \"featureFlags\" = jsonb_set(\n  COALESCE(\"featureFlags\", '{}'::jsonb),\n  '{weeklyDropsEnabled}',\n  'true'::jsonb\n)\nWHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n\n-- Disable a feature\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" \nSET \"featureFlags\" = jsonb_set(\n  COALESCE(\"featureFlags\", '{}'::jsonb),\n  '{weeklyDropsEnabled}',\n  'false'::jsonb\n)\nWHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n\n-- Set multiple flags\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" \nSET \"featureFlags\" = '{\"weeklyDropsEnabled\": true, \"analyticsEnabled\": false}'::jsonb\nWHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Available Feature Flags\n\n- &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled&#96; - Enable weekly drop functionality\n- &#96;analyticsEnabled&#96; - Enable analytics dashboard (V2)\n- &#96;customDomainsEnabled&#96; - Enable custom domains (V2)\n- &#96;whiteLabelEnabled&#96; - Enable white-label mode (V2)\n\n## Integration Points\n\n### Where to Add Kill Switch Checks\n\nAdd &#96;requireActiveMerchant()&#96; checks to:\n\n1. **Voucher Creation** (&#96;app/api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/route.ts&#96;)\n   - Block new vouchers for inactive merchants\n\n2. **Voucher Publishing** (&#96;app/api/vouchers/[id]/publish/route.ts&#96;)\n   - Block publishing for inactive merchants\n\n3. **Public Voucher Pages** (&#96;app/v/[id]/page.tsx&#96;)\n   - Hide vouchers from inactive merchants\n\n4. **Public Referral Pages** (&#96;app/r/[id]/page.tsx&#96;)\n   - Hide referrals from inactive merchants\n\n5. **Redemption Creation** (&#96;app/api/redemptions/route.ts&#96;)\n   - Allow existing redemptions, but log warning",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\app\\api\\redemptions\\route.ts",
        "range": {

          "endPosition": {
            "line": 177,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { checkRedemptionRateLimit, isSelfReferral, checkIPRateLimit } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { requireActiveMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createRedemptionSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  referralId: z.string().optional(),\n  method: z.enum(['online', 'in_store']),\n  orderReference: z.string().optional(),\n  amountBeforeDiscount: z.number().int().positive(),\n  discountApplied: z.number().int().nonnegative(),\n  currency: z.string(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    // IP-based rate limiting for public redemptions\n    const ip = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0] || \n               req.headers.get('x-real-ip') || \n               'unknown';\n    const ipRateLimit = checkIPRateLimit(ip, 60, 50); // 50 per hour per IP\n    if (!ipRateLimit.allowed) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: ipRateLimit.remaining },\n        { status: 429 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    const session = await auth();\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const data = createRedemptionSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: data.voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    // Check merchant is active (kill switch)\n    try {\n      await requireActiveMerchant(voucher.merchantId);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      if (error.message?.includes('inactive')) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant is inactive' }, { status: 403 });\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published')\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { applyCredit } from '@/lib/credits';\nimport { getMerchantBySlug } from '@/lib/tenant';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst applyCreditSchema = z.object({\n  merchantSlug: z.string(),\n  amount: z.number().int().positive(),\n  orderReference: z.string().optional(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const { merchantSlug, amount, orderReference } = applyCreditSchema.parse(body);\n\n    const merchant = await getMerchantBySlug(merchantSlug);\n    if (!merchant) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    const result = await applyCredit(session.user.id, merchant.id, amount, orderReference || '');\n\n    return NextResponse.json(result);\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    if (error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.message === 'Insufficient credit balance') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    console.error('Error applying credit:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

      "codeBlock": {

        "contents": "│   ├── tenant.ts         # Multi-tenant utilities\n│   ├── fraud.ts          # Fraud prevention\n│   └── credits.ts        # Credit management\n├── prisma/               # Prisma schema and migrations\n│   ├── schema.prisma     # Database schema\n│   └── seed.ts           # Seed script\n└── public/               # Static assets\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Core Flows\n\n### 1. Merchant Creates Voucher\n\n1. Navigate to &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n2. Fill in voucher details (type, value, validity, limits)\n3. Configure weekly drop (optional)\n4. Design voucher (colors, headline, fine print)\n5. Publish voucher\n\n### 2. User Shares Voucher\n\n1. User opens voucher landing page (&#96;/v/[id]&#96;)\n2. Clicks \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"\n3. System creates referral and generates share URL\n4. User shares link via native share sheet or copy\n\n### 3. Friend Redeems Voucher\n\n1. Friend opens referral link (&#96;/r/[id]&#96;)\n2. Sees branded voucher with QR code\n3. Redeems online or in-store\n4. System creates redemption (unconfirmed for in-store)\n5. Locked credit created for referrer\n\n### 4. Staff Confirms Redemption\n\n1. Staff views redemptions at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96;\n2. Confirms in-store redemption\n3. Credit unlocks for referrer\n\n### 5. Referrer Uses Credit\n\n1. View wallet at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet&#96;\n2. Go to checkout demo at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96;\n3. Apply credit to order\n\n## API Endpoints\n\nSee [API Documentation](./docs/API.md) for complete API reference.\n\n### Merchant Vouchers\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Create voucher\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - List vouchers\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Get voucher\n- &#96;PUT /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Update voucher\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish voucher\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/purchase&#96; - Purchase voucher (Stripe checkout)\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/grant&#96; - Grant free voucher\n\n### Campaigns\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/campaigns&#96; - Create campaign\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/campaigns&#96; - List campaigns\n- &#96;GET /api/campaigns/[id]&#96; - Get campaign\n- &#96;PUT /api/campaigns/[id]&#96; - Update campaign\n- &#96;POST /api/campaigns/[id]/generate-vouchers&#96; - Generate vouchers from campaign\n\n### Events\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/events&#96; - Create event\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/events&#96; - List events\n- &#96;GET /api/events/[id]&#96; - Get event\n- &#96;PUT /api/events/[id]&#96; - Update event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/generate-tickets&#96; - Generate tickets for event",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s\n- ✅ Share in 1 tap\n- ✅ No signup wall on public pages\n- ✅ Available credit BIG in wallet\n- ✅ Locked credit clearly separated\n- ✅ Expiry visible\n\n### Data Model\nAll required models present:\n- ✅ Merchant\n- ✅ MerchantMember\n- ✅ User\n- ✅ Voucher\n- ✅ Referral\n- ✅ Redemption\n- ✅ CreditLedger\n- ✅ CreditUsage\n- ✅ AuditLog\n\nBusiness rules:\n- ✅ Credit ≠ money\n- ✅ Credit per-merchant\n- ✅ Credit expires (60 days default)\n- ✅ Credit starts LOCKED\n- ✅ Unlock only after redemption confirmation\n- ✅ No self-referral\n- ✅ Weekly drops have fixed stock\n\n### Core Flows (All Working)\n- ✅ **A)** Merchant creates voucher → publish\n- ✅ **B)** User shares voucher\n- ✅ **C)** Friend redeems voucher\n- ✅ **D)** Staff confirms redemption\n- ✅ **E)** Credit unlocks\n- ✅ **F)** User applies credit in checkout demo\n\n### Weekly Drops\n- ✅ Optional per voucher\n- ✅ Time window + stock\n- ✅ First come, first served\n- ✅ No notifications in MVP\n\n### Security &amp; Fraud\n- ✅ Rate limits\n- ✅ Device/IP heuristics\n- ✅ Hashed friend identifiers\n- ✅ Audit admin/staff actions\n\n### PWA Requirements\n- ✅ Installable (manifest.json)\n- ✅ Native mobile share\n- ✅ Offline QR for opened vouchers\n- ✅ Works on iOS &amp; Android browsers\n\n### Forbidden Features\n- ✅ No marketplace\n- ✅ No public feeds (except &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; which should be removed)\n- ✅ No comments\n- ✅ No likes\n- ✅ No loyalty tiers\n- ✅ No AI\n- ✅ No ads\n- ✅ No influencer dashboards\n\n## ⚠️ Action Items\n\n### High Priority\n1. **Remove &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; page** - Not in MVP scope per spec\n2. **Hide non-MVP links** - ✅ Done (removed from dashboard)\n\n### Medium Priority\n3. **Verify all 8 done definition steps work locally**\n4. **Test PWA on iOS/Android**\n\n### Low Priority\n5. **Add feature flags to Merchant model** (for launch mode)\n6. **Implement kill switch** (for launch mode)",

UI Komponendid\n- ✅ &#96;Select&#96; komponent (Radix UI)\n- ✅ &#96;Skeleton&#96; loading komponent\n- ✅ &#96;LoadingButton&#96; komponent\n- ✅ &#96;Toast&#96; süsteem\n\n## 📋 Järgmised sammud (valikuline)\n\n### Prioriteet 1\n1. **Asendada kõik alert() kutsed toast'idega**\n   - &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new/page.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/redemptions/confirm-button.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/r/[id]/referral-client.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo/page.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/v/[id]/voucher-client.tsx&#96;\n\n2. **Voucher otsing ja filtreerimine**\n   - Otsing välja\n   - Filtreerimine staatuse, tüübi, kuupäeva järgi\n   - Sortimine\n\n3. **Parem error handling UI**\n   - Error boundaries\n   - Retry mechanisms\n\n### Prioriteet 2\n4. **Email notifications**\n   - Credit unlock notifications\n   - Redemption confirmations\n   - Weekly drop reminders\n\n5. **Voucher mallid**\n   - Eeldefineeritud mallid\n   - Mallide salvestamine\n   - Kiire loomine\n\n6. **Export funktsioonid**\n   - CSV export redemptions\n   - Credits ledger export\n\n### Prioriteet 3\n7. **Graafikud ja visualisatsioonid**\n   - Chart.js või Recharts integratsioon\n   - Time-series graafikud\n   - Conversion funnels\n\n8. **Bulk operations**\n   - Mitme voucher'i korraga avaldamine\n   - CSV import\n\n## 🚀 Kuidas kasutada",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp;         "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n\n\n    if (!weeklyDrop) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Weekly drop configuration missing' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check if we're in the drop window\n    const now = new Date();\n    const dayOfWeek = now.getDay();\n    const [hours, minutes] = weeklyDrop.startTime.split(':').map(Number);\n    const startTime = new Date(now);\n    startTime.setHours(hours, minutes, 0, 0);\n    const endTime = new Date(startTime);\n    endTime.setMinutes(endTime.getMinutes() + weeklyDrop.durationMinutes);\n\n    if (dayOfWeek !== weeklyDrop.dayOfWeek || now &lt; startTime || now &gt; endTime) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Weekly drop not active' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Atomically check stock and create referral\n    const result = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) =&gt; {\n      // Count existing referrals for this voucher created in this drop window\n      const existingCount = await tx.referral.count({\n        where: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          createdAt: {\n            gte: startTime,\n            lte: endTime,\n          },\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (existingCount &gt;= weeklyDrop.stock) {\n        throw new Error('Weekly drop sold out');\n      }\n\n      // Create referral\n      const friendHash = friendHint\n        ? await hashFriendIdentifier(friendHint)\n        : &#96;anonymous_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}&#96;;\n\n      const referral = await tx.referral.create({\n        data: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n          referrerUserId: session.user.id,\n          friendHash,\n          status: 'created',\n        },\n      });\n\n      return referral;\n    });\n\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${result.id}&#96;;\n\n    return NextResponse.json({\n      referralId: result.id,\n      shareUrl,\n      remaining: weeklyDrop.stock - 1, // Approximate\n    });\n  } catch (error)\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Handle errors and return appropriate HTTP response\n */\nexport function handleError(error: unknown): { status: number; error: string; code?: string } {\n  if (error instanceof AppError) {\n    return {\n      status: error.statusCode,\n      error: error.message,\n      code: error.code,\n    };\n  }\n\n  if (error instanceof Error) {\n    console.error('Unhandled error:', error);\n    return {\n      status: 500,\n      error: 'Internal server error',\n    };\n  }\n\n  return {\n    status: 500,\n    error: 'Unknown error',\n  };\n}",

        "range": {

        "contents": "# Launch Mode Configuration\n\nPer specification section 15, the platform is prepared for **invite-only merchants** with **manual onboarding**.\n\n## Current Implementation\n\n### Platform Admin\n- **Route**: &#96;/admin&#96;\n- **Access**: Environment variable &#96;PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS&#96;\n- **Purpose**: Manual merchant onboarding and monitoring\n- **Status**: Minimal implementation (ready for expansion)\n\n### Merchant Member Management\n- **Route**: &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;\n- **Access**: Merchant admin only\n- **Purpose**: Add/remove merchant staff\n- **Status**: Basic UI (add via database/API for now)\n\n## Feature Flags (To Implement)\n\nThe specification requires:\n- Feature flags per merchant\n- Kill switch per merchant\n- Invite-only merchant signup\n\n### Recommended Implementation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Add to Merchant model\nmodel Merchant {\n  // ... existing fields\n  isActive      Boolean @default(true)  // Kill switch\n  featureFlags  Json?                   // Per-merchant feature flags\n  invitedAt    DateTime?                // Track manual invites\n  onboardedAt  DateTime?                // Track onboarding completion\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Feature Flag Examples\n- &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;customDomainsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;analyticsEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n- &#96;whiteLabelEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n\n## Manual Onboarding Flow\n\n1. **Platform admin** creates merchant via database/API\n2. **Platform admin** adds merchant admin user via &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; or database\n3. **Merchant admin** receives invite email (to implement)\n4. **Merchant admin** logs in and completes onboarding\n5. **Merchant** can start creating vouchers\n\n## Kill Switch\n\nTo disable a merchant:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis should:\n- Hide merchant from public routes\n- Prevent new voucher creation\n- Allow existing redemptions to complete\n- Log action in AuditLog\n\n## No Public Signup\n\n- ✅ No public merchant signup form\n- ✅ No public user registration (except via OAuth/magic link)",

        "contents": "6. **Implement kill switch** (for launch mode)\n\n## 📋 Done Definition Verification\n\nTo verify MVP is complete, test locally:\n\n1. ✅ Open voucher page (&#96;/v/[id]&#96;)\n2. ✅ Create referral (click \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\")\n3. ✅ Share link (native share or copy)\n4. ✅ Friend redeems (open link in incognito, redeem)\n5. ✅ Staff confirms (go to redemptions, click confirm)\n6. ✅ Credit appears locked (check wallet)\n7. ✅ Credit unlocks (after confirmation, check wallet)\n8. ✅ Credit applied in checkout demo (go to checkout-demo, apply credit)\n\n## 🎯 Launch Readiness\n\n### Ready\n- ✅ Core flows working\n- ✅ MVP pages complete\n- ✅ Security &amp; fraud prevention\n- ✅ PWA functional\n- ✅ Data model correct\n- ✅ Business rules enforced\n\n### Needs Attention\n- ⚠️ Remove &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; page\n- ⚠️ Test all 8 done definition steps\n- ⚠️ Verify iOS PWA compatibility\n- ⚠️ Add feature flags (launch mode)\n\n### V2 (Documented Only)\n- 📝 See &#96;V2_BACKLOG.md&#96;\n- 📝 See &#96;LAUNCH_MODE.md&#96;\n\n## Summary\n\n**Status**: ✅ **MVP COMPLIANT** (with minor cleanup needed)\n\nThe platform matches the specification.         "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { hashFriendIdentifier } from '@/lib/utils';\nimport { checkReferralRateLimit } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createReferralSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  friendHint: z.string().optional(), // optional identifier hint for friend\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const { voucherId, friendHint } = createReferralSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not available' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check rate limit\n    const rateLimit = await checkReferralRateLimit(session.user.id);\n    if (!rateLimit.allowed) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: rateLimit.remaining },\n        { status: 429 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Hash friend identifier if provided\n    const friendHash = friendHint\n      ? await hashFriendIdentifier(friendHint)\n      : &#96;anonymous_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}&#96;;\n\n    // Create referral\n    const referral = await prisma.referral.create({\n      data: {\n        voucherId: voucher.id,\n        merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n        referrerUserId: session.user.id,\n        friendHash,\n        status: 'created',\n      },\n    });\n\n    // Generate share URL\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${referral.id}&#96;;\n\n    return NextResponse.json\n\n}",

        "contents": "# Changelog\n\n## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-XX\n\n### Added\n- Multi-tenant voucher platform with merchant isolation\n- Voucher creation, publishing, and management\n- Referral system with shareable links\n- Credit system (locked/unlocked states)\n- Weekly drop functionality with stock management\n- PWA support with service worker and offline QR codes\n- RBAC (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- Fraud prevention (rate limiting, self-referral prevention)\n- Email magic link authentication\n- Google and Apple OAuth support\n- Merchant dashboard\n- User wallet and credit management\n- Checkout demo for credit application\n- API documentation\n- Unit tests for credit system\n- Seed data script\n- Docker compose setup for local development\n\n### Technical\n- Next.js 14 with App Router\n- TypeScript strict mode\n- Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL\n- TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui components\n- NextAuth for authentication\n- Zod for validation\n- Vitest for testing\n- i18n structure (next-intl, ready for expansion)\n\n## [1.1.0] - 2024-01-XX (Planned)\n\n### Added\n- Voucher publish endpoint\n- Voucher update endpoint\n- Better error handling with custom error classes\n- Type definitions\n- Session provider for client components\n- Validation utilities\n\n### Fixed\n- Missing publish functionality\n- TypeScript type safety improvements",

Post-Deployment\n\n#### Verify\n- [ ] Homepage loads\n- [ ] Login works\n- [ ] Magic link emails sent\n- [ ] OAuth providers work (if configured)\n- [ ] Voucher pages load\n- [ ] Referral pages load\n- [ ] PWA installable\n- [ ] Service worker active\n\n#### Test Core Flows\n- [ ] Create voucher\n- [ ] Create campaign\n- [ ] Generate vouchers from campaign\n- [ ] Purchase voucher (Stripe checkout)\n- [ ] Publish voucher\n- [ ] Share referral\n- [ ] Redeem voucher\n- [ ] Confirm redemption\n- [ ] Credit unlocks\n- [ ] Apply credit\n- [ ] Create event\n- [ ] Generate tickets for event\n- [ ] Purchase ticket (Stripe checkout)\n\n#### Monitor\n- [ ] Error logs checked\n- [ ] Performance metrics reviewed\n- [ ] Database connections stable\n- [ ] API response times acceptable\n\n## Launch Mode Setup\n\n### Initial Setup\n- [ ] Run launch mode migration\n- [ ] Create first merchant via database\n- [ ] Add merchant admin user\n- [ ] Test merchant dashboard access\n- [ ] Verify kill switch works\n\n### Merchant Onboarding\n- [ ] Document onboarding process\n- [ ] Create merchant invite template\n- [ ] Set up merchant creation workflow\n- [ ] Test feature flags\n\n## Monitoring\n\n### Set Up\n- [ ] Error tracking (Sentry, etc.)\n- [ ] Performance monitoring\n- [ ] Database monitoring\n- [ ] Uptime monitoring\n- [ ] Log aggregation\n\n### Alerts\n- [ ] Database connection failures\n- [ ] High error rates\n- [ ] Slow API responses\n- [ ] Merchant deactivations\n- [ ] Unusual redemption patterns\n\n## Rollback Plan\n\n### If Issues Occur\n1. **Immediate**: Deactivate problematic merchants via kill switch\n2. **Short-term**: Revert deployment if critical bug\n3. **Long-term**: Fix issue and redeploy\n\n### Rollback Steps\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 1. Revert code deployment\n# 2. Check database migrations (may need to rollback)\n# 3. Verify environment variables\n# 4.         "contents": "'use client';\n\nimport { useEffect } from 'react';\n\nexport default function GlobalError({\n  error,\n  reset,\n}: {\n  error: Error &amp; { digest?: string };\n  reset: () =&gt; void;\n}) {\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {\n      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console\n      console.error('Global error:', error);\n    }\n  }, [error]);\n\n  // Note: Global error cannot use next-intl hooks, so we use fallback text\n  // This is a critical error boundary that must work even if i18n fails\n  const errorStyles = &#96;\n    .ge-root { min-height: 100vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 1rem; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; }\n    .ge-h1 { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }\n    .ge-p { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #666; margin-bottom: 1rem; }\n    .ge-btn { padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 0.375rem; border: 1px solid #ccc; background: #fff; cursor: pointer; }\n  &#96;;\n  return (\n    &lt;html lang=\"en\"&gt;\n      &lt;head&gt;\n        &lt;style&gt;{errorStyles}&lt;/style&gt;\n      &lt;/head&gt;\n      &lt;body&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"ge-root\"&gt;\n          &lt;h1 className=\"ge-h1\"&gt;Something went wrong&lt;/h1&gt;\n          &lt;p className=\"ge-p\"&gt;A critical error occurred.         "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { applyCredit } from '@/lib/credits';\nimport { getMerchantBySlug } from '@/lib/tenant';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst applyCreditSchema = z.object({\n  merchantSlug: z.string(),\n  amount: z.number().int().positive(),\n  orderReference: z.string().optional(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const { merchantSlug, amount, orderReference } = applyCreditSchema.parse(body);\n\n    const merchant = await getMerchantBySlug(merchantSlug);\n    if (!merchant) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    const result = await applyCredit(session.user.id, merchant.id, amount, orderReference || '');\n\n    return NextResponse.json(result);\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    if (error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.message === 'Insufficient credit balance') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    console.error('Error applying credit:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { checkRedemptionRateLimit, isSelfReferral, checkIPRateLimit } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { requireActiveMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createRedemptionSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  referralId: z.string().optional(),\n  method: z.enum(['online', 'in_store']),\n  orderReference: z.string().optional(),\n  amountBeforeDiscount: z.number().int().positive(),\n  discountApplied: z.number().int().nonnegative(),\n  currency: z.string(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    // IP-based rate limiting for public redemptions\n    const ip = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0] || \n               req.headers.get('x-real-ip') || \n               'unknown';\n    const ipRateLimit = checkIPRateLimit(ip, 60, 50); // 50 per hour per IP\n    if (!ipRateLimit.allowed) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: ipRateLimit.remaining },\n        { status: 429 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    const session = await auth();\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const data = createRedemptionSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: data.voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    // Check merchant is active (kill switch)\n    try {\n      await requireActiveMerchant(voucher.merchantId);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      if (error.message?.includes('inactive')) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant is inactive' }, { status: 403 });\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published')\n}",

        "contents": "const createVoucherSchema = \n\n  designJson: z.any().optional(),\n  codePrefix: z.string().optional(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { slug: string } }\n) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n      where: { slug: params.slug },\n    });\n\n    if (!merchant) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    await requireActiveMerchant(merchant.id);\n    await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_admin');\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const data = createVoucherSchema.parse(body);\n\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.create({\n      data: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        status: 'draft',\n        ...data,\n        validFrom: new Date(data.validFrom),\n        validTo: new Date(data.validTo),\n        weeklyDropJson: data.weeklyDropJson ? JSON.stringify(data.weeklyDropJson) : Prisma.DbNull,\n        conditionsJson: data.conditionsJson ? JSON.stringify(data.conditionsJson) : Prisma.DbNull,\n        designJson: data.designJson ? JSON.stringify(data.designJson) : Prisma.DbNull,\n      },\n    });\n\n    return NextResponse.json(voucher);\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    console.error('Error creating voucher:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\app\\api\\weekly-drop\\claim\\route.ts",
        "range": {

          "endPosition": {
            "line": 124,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n\n\n    if (!weeklyDrop) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Weekly drop configuration missing' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check if we're in the drop window\n    const now = new Date();\n    const dayOfWeek = now.getDay();\n    const [hours, minutes] = weeklyDrop.startTime.split(':').map(Number);\n    const startTime = new Date(now);\n    startTime.setHours(hours, minutes, 0, 0);\n    const endTime = new Date(startTime);\n    endTime.setMinutes(endTime.getMinutes() + weeklyDrop.durationMinutes);\n\n    if (dayOfWeek !== weeklyDrop.dayOfWeek || now &lt; startTime || now &gt; endTime) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Weekly drop not active' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Atomically check stock and create referral\n    const result = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) =&gt; {\n      // Count existing referrals for this voucher created in this drop window\n      const existingCount = await tx.referral.count({\n        where: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          createdAt: {\n            gte: startTime,\n            lte: endTime,\n          },\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (existingCount &gt;= weeklyDrop.stock) {\n        throw new Error('Weekly drop sold out');\n      }\n\n      // Create referral\n      const friendHash = friendHint\n        ? await hashFriendIdentifier(friendHint)\n        : &#96;anonymous_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}&#96;;\n\n      const referral = await tx.referral.create({\n        data: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n          referrerUserId: session.user.id,\n          friendHash,\n          status: 'created',\n        },\n      });\n\n      return referral;\n    });\n\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${result.id}&#96;;\n\n    return NextResponse.json({\n      referralId: result.id,\n      shareUrl,\n      remaining: weeklyDrop.stock - 1, // Approximate\n    });\n  } catch (error)\n}",

        "contents": "export async function GET(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { slug: string; id: string } }\n) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n      where: { slug: params.slug },\n    });\n\n    if (!merchant) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: params.id },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher || voucher.merchantId !== merchant.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    // Check permissions\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published') {\n      if (!session?.user?.id) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n      }\n      try {\n        await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_staff');\n      } catch {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden' }, { status: 403 });\n      }\n    }\n\n    return NextResponse.json(voucher);\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error fetching voucher:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export async function POST(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { slug: string } }\n) {\n\n  }\n}\n\nexport async function GET(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { slug: string } }\n) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n      where: { slug: params.slug },\n    });\n\n    if (!merchant) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    // If authenticated and has merchant role, show all vouchers\n    // Otherwise, show only published vouchers\n    const where: {\n      merchantId: string;\n      status?: string;\n    } = { merchantId: merchant.id };\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      where.status = 'published';\n    } else {\n      try {\n        await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_staff');\n      } catch {\n        where.status = 'published';\n      }\n    }\n\n    const vouchers = await prisma.voucher.findMany({\n      where,\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    });\n\n    return NextResponse.json(vouchers);\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error fetching vouchers:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { getCreditBalance } from '@/lib/credits';\nimport { getMerchantBySlug } from '@/lib/tenant';\n\nexport async function GET(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { merchantSlug: string } }\n) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const merchant = await getMerchantBySlug(params.merchantSlug);\n    if (!merchant) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    const balance = await getCreditBalance(session.user.id, merchant.id);\n\n    return NextResponse.json(balance);\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error fetching wallet:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Audit\n\n## ✅ MVP Pages (Required &amp; Present)\n\n### PUBLIC\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page  \n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n### USER\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ⚠️ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/vouchers&#96; - User vouchers (not explicitly in spec, but useful for flow B)\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo (required for flow F)\n\n### MERCHANT\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n## ⚠️ Non-MVP Pages (Present but Not in Scope)\n\nThese pages exist but are NOT in the MVP specification:\n\n1. **&#96;/admin&#96;** - Platform admin dashboard\n   - Status: Present, minimal implementation\n   - Action: Keep for launch mode (manual onboarding), but document as internal-only\n\n2. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96;** - Analytics dashboard\n   - Status: Present with charts/stats\n   - Action: **REMOVE or hide** - Not in MVP scope\n\n3. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96;** - Referral analytics\n   - Status: Present with referral stats\n   - Action: **REMOVE or hide** - Not in MVP scope\n\n4. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;** - Member management\n   - Status: Present, minimal\n   - Action: Keep for launch mode (manual onboarding), but hide from navigation\n\n5. **&#96;/m/[slug]&#96;** - Public merchant landing page\n   - Status: Present, shows merchant vouchers\n   - Action: **REMOVE** - Not in MVP scope (spec says \"NO OTHER PAGES\")\n\n## ✅ Core Flows Verification\n\n### A) Merchant creates voucher → publish\n- ✅ Voucher builder at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n- ✅ Publish endpoint: &#96;/api/vouchers/[id]/publish&#96;\n- ✅ Status: Working\n\n### B) User shares voucher\n- ✅ Share button on &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n- ✅ Creates referral via &#96;/api/referrals/create&#96;\n- ✅ Generates share URL &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96;\n- ✅ Status: Working",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { hashFriendIdentifier } from '@/lib/utils';\nimport { checkReferralRateLimit } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createReferralSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  friendHint: z.string().optional(), // optional identifier hint for friend\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const { voucherId, friendHint } = createReferralSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not available' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check rate limit\n    const rateLimit = await checkReferralRateLimit(session.user.id);\n    if (!rateLimit.allowed) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: rateLimit.remaining },\n        { status: 429 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Hash friend identifier if provided\n    const friendHash = friendHint\n      ? JSON.stringify(data.weeklyDropJson) : Prisma.DbNull;\n    }\n    if (data.conditionsJson !== undefined) {\n      updateData.conditionsJson = data.conditionsJson ?         "contents": "# API Documentation\n\n## Authentication\n\nMost endpoints require authentication via NextAuth session cookie. Include the session cookie in requests.\n\n## Endpoints\n\n### Merchant Vouchers\n\n#### Create Voucher\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;http\nPOST /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Auth**: Merchant admin required\n\n**Body**:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"type\": \"percentage\" | \"fixed_amount\" | \"credit_amount\",\n  \"value\": 1500,  // basis points for percentage, minor units for money\n  \"currency\": \"USD\",\n  \"validFrom\": \"2024-01-01T00:00:00Z\",\n  \"validTo\": \"2024-01-31T23:59:59Z\",\n  \"usageLimitTotal\": 100,  // optional\n  \"usageLimitPerUser\": 1,  // optional\n  \"weeklyDropEnabled\": false,\n  \"weeklyDropJson\": {  // optional\n    \"dayOfWeek\": 1,\n    \"startTime\": \"10:00\",\n    \"stock\": 20,\n    \"durationMinutes\": 60\n  },\n  \"designJson\": {\n    \"headline\": \"15% Off\",\n    \"finePrint\": \"Valid for new customers\",\n    \"primaryColor\": \"#000000\",\n    \"secondaryColor\": \"#666666\",\n    \"backgroundColor\": \"#ffffff\"\n  },\n  \"codePrefix\": \"CH\"  // optional\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Response**: Voucher object\n\n#### List Vouchers\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;http\nGET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Auth**: Optional (public sees only published)\n\n**Response**: Array of voucher objects\n\n#### Get Voucher\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;http\nGET         "contents": "# MVP Compliance Audit\n\n## ✅ MVP Pages (Required &amp; Present)\n\n### PUBLIC\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page  \n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n### USER\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ⚠️ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/vouchers&#96; - User vouchers (not explicitly in spec, but useful for flow B)\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo (required for flow F)\n\n### MERCHANT\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;         "contents": "# Launch Mode Configuration\n\nPer specification section 15, the platform is prepared for **invite-only merchants** with **manual onboarding**.\n\n## Current Implementation\n\n### Platform Admin\n- **Route**: &#96;/admin&#96;\n- **Access**: Environment variable &#96;PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS&#96;\n- **Purpose**: Manual merchant onboarding and monitoring\n- **Status**: Minimal implementation (ready for expansion)\n\n### Merchant Member Management\n- **Route**: &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;\n- **Access**: Merchant admin only\n- **Purpose**: Add/remove merchant staff\n- **Status**: Basic UI (add via database/API for now)\n\n## Feature Flags (To Implement)\n\nThe specification requires:\n- Feature flags per merchant\n- Kill switch per merchant\n- Invite-only merchant signup\n\n### Recommended Implementation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Add to Merchant model\nmodel Merchant {\n  // ... existing fields\n  isActive      Boolean @default(true)  // Kill switch\n  featureFlags  Json?                   // Per-merchant feature flags\n  invitedAt    DateTime?                // Track manual invites\n  onboardedAt  DateTime?                // Track onboarding completion\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Feature Flag Examples\n- &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;customDomainsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;analyticsEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n- &#96;whiteLabelEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n\n## Manual Onboarding Flow\n\n1. **Platform admin** creates merchant via database/API\n2. **Platform admin** adds merchant admin user via &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; or database\n3. **Merchant admin** receives invite email (to implement)\n4. **Merchant admin** logs in and completes onboarding\n5. **Merchant** can start creating vouchers\n\n## Kill Switch\n\nTo disable a merchant:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis should:\n- Hide merchant from public routes\n- Prevent new voucher creation\n- Allow existing redemptions to complete\n- Log action in AuditLog\n\n## No Public Signup\n\n- ✅ No public merchant signup form\n- ✅ No public user registration (except via OAuth/magic link)",

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "### Feature Flag Examples",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;customDomainsEnabled: boolean&#96;",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;whiteLabelEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "## Manual Onboarding Flow",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Platform admin** creates merchant via database/API",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Platform admin** adds merchant admin user via &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; or database",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Merchant admin** receives invite email (to implement)",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **Merchant admin** logs in and completes onboarding",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "5. **Merchant** can start creating vouchers",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "## Kill Switch",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "To disable a merchant:",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "UPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "This should:",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "- Hide merchant from public routes",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "- Prevent new voucher creation",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "- Allow existing redemptions to complete",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "- Log action in AuditLog",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "## No Public Signup",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ No public merchant signup form",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {

          }
        ]

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp;         "contents": "- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s\n- ✅ Share in 1 tap\n- ✅ No signup wall on public pages\n- ✅ Available credit BIG in wallet\n- ✅ Locked credit clearly separated\n- ✅ Expiry visible\n\n### Data Model\nAll required models present:\n- ✅ Merchant\n- ✅ MerchantMember\n- ✅ User\n- ✅ Voucher\n- ✅ Referral\n- ✅ Redemption\n- ✅ CreditLedger\n- ✅ CreditUsage\n- ✅ AuditLog\n\nBusiness rules:\n- ✅ Credit ≠ money\n- ✅ Credit per-merchant\n- ✅ Credit expires (60 days default)\n- ✅ Credit starts LOCKED\n- ✅ Unlock only after redemption confirmation\n- ✅ No self-referral\n- ✅ Weekly drops have fixed stock\n\n### Core Flows (All Working)\n- ✅ **A)** Merchant creates voucher → publish\n- ✅ **B)** User shares voucher\n- ✅ **C)** Friend redeems voucher\n- ✅ **D)** Staff confirms redemption\n- ✅ **E)** Credit unlocks\n- ✅ **F)** User applies credit in checkout demo\n\n### Weekly Drops\n- ✅ Optional per voucher\n- ✅ Time window + stock\n- ✅ First come, first served\n- ✅ No notifications in MVP\n\n### Security &amp; Fraud\n- ✅ Rate limits\n- ✅ Device/IP heuristics\n- ✅ Hashed friend identifiers\n- ✅ Audit admin/staff actions\n\n### PWA Requirements\n- ✅ Installable (manifest.json)\n- ✅ Native mobile share\n- ✅ Offline QR for opened vouchers\n- ✅ Works on iOS &amp; Android browsers\n\n### Forbidden Features\n- ✅ No marketplace\n- ✅ No public feeds (except &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; which should be removed)\n- ✅ No comments\n- ✅ No likes\n- ✅ No loyalty tiers\n- ✅ No AI\n- ✅ No ads\n- ✅ No influencer dashboards\n\n## ⚠️ Action Items\n\n### High Priority\n1. **Remove &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; page** - Not in MVP scope per spec\n2. **Hide non-MVP links** - ✅ Done (removed from dashboard)\n\n### Medium Priority\n3. **Verify all 8 done definition steps work locally**\n4. **Test PWA on iOS/Android**\n\n### Low Priority\n5. **Add feature flags to Merchant model** (for launch mode)\n6. **Implement kill switch** (for launch mode)",

        "range": {

        "contents": "# Vouchr\n\nMerchant-owned referral infrastructure: branded vouchers and store credit. Pay for results, not reach. Production-ready, global, multi-tenant; Web and PWA.\n\n**Status**: ✅ MVP Complete - Ready for launch mode testing\n\nSee [MVP_COMPLIANCE.md](docs/MVP_COMPLIANCE.md) for full compliance report.\n\n## Quick Links\n\n- [Testing Guide](docs/TESTING_GUIDE.md) - Test all 8 MVP flows\n- [Launch Mode Guide](docs/LAUNCH_MODE_IMPLEMENTATION.md) - Kill switch &amp; feature flags\n- [Deployment Checklist](docs/DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md) - Pre-production checklist\n- [V2 Backlog](docs/V2_BACKLOG.md) - Future features (documented only)\n\n## Features\n\n- **Multi-tenant Architecture**: Each merchant is a tenant with isolated data\n- **Voucher Management**: Create, publish, and manage vouchers with custom designs\n- **Campaign Management**: Create campaigns with pricing, limits, and referral credit percentages\n- **Event Management**: Create events with tickets, capacity management, and ticket types\n- **Referral System**: Users share vouchers; referrers earn merchant-specific credit\n- **Credit System**: Non-transferable, per-merchant credits that expire\n- **Weekly Drops**: Limited-time voucher drops with stock management\n- **PWA Support**: Installable web app with offline QR code generation\n- **RBAC**: Role-based access control (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- **Fraud Prevention**: Rate limiting, self-referral prevention, risk signals\n- **Stripe Integration**: Payment processing for voucher and ticket purchases\n\n## Tech Stack\n\n- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 (App Router), React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui\n- **Backend**: Next.js Route Handlers, NextAuth\n- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM\n- **Cache**: Redis (optional for local dev)\n- **Auth**: Email magic link, Google OAuth, Apple OAuth\n\n## Getting Started\n\n### Prerequisites\n\n- Node.js 18+\n- Docker and Docker Compose (for local database)\n- PostgreSQL 16+ (if not using Docker)\n\n### Installation\n\n1. Clone the repository:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   git clone &lt;repository-url&gt;\n   cd voucher\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Install dependencies:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Set up environment variables:",

        "contents": "import NextAuth from 'next-auth';\nimport { PrismaAdapter } from '@auth/prisma-adapter';\nimport EmailProvider from 'next-auth/providers/email';\nimport GoogleProvider from 'next-auth/providers/google';\nimport AppleProvider from 'next-auth/providers/apple';\nimport FacebookProvider from 'next-auth/providers/facebook';\nimport GitHubProvider from 'next-auth/providers/github';\nimport TwitterProvider from 'next-auth/providers/twitter';\nimport LinkedInProvider from 'next-auth/providers/linkedin';\nimport Credentials from 'next-auth/providers/credentials';\nimport { prisma } from './prisma';\n\nconst testEmail = process.env.TEST_USER_EMAIL ?? (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' ? 'test@example.com' : '');\nconst testPassword = process.env.TEST_USER_PASSWORD ?? (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' ?         "contents": "# Deployment Checklist\n\nUse this checklist before deploying to production.\n\n## Pre-Deployment\n\n### Environment Variables\n- [ ] &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; - Production PostgreSQL connection string\n- [ ] &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96; - Random 32+ character string\n- [ ] &#96;NEXTAUTH_URL&#96; - Production URL (e.g., https://voucher.example.com)\n- [ ] &#96;NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL&#96; - Production URL (e.g., https://voucher.example.com)\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_HOST&#96; - Email server for magic links\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_PORT&#96; - Email server port\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_USER&#96; - Email server username\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_PASSWORD&#96; - Email server password\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_FROM&#96; - From email address\n- [ ] &#96;RESEND_API_KEY&#96; - Resend API key (recommended for transactional emails)\n- [ ] &#96;RESEND_FROM_EMAIL&#96; - Default \"from\" address for Resend\n- [ ] &#96;STRIPE_SECRET_KEY&#96; - Stripe secret key (required for payments)\n- [ ] &#96;STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET&#96; - Stripe webhook signing secret (required for webhooks)\n- [ ] &#96;NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY&#96; - Stripe publishable key (client-side)\n- [ ] &#96;GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID&#96; - Google OAuth (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET&#96; - Google OAuth (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_ID&#96; - Apple OAuth client ID (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_SECRET&#96; - Apple OAuth secret (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_TEAM_ID&#96; - Apple OAuth team ID (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_KEY_ID&#96; - Apple OAuth key ID (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY&#96; - Apple OAuth private key (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS&#96; - Comma-separated admin emails\n- [ ] &#96;REDIS_URL&#96; - Redis connection (optional, for rate limiting)\n\n### Database\n- [ ] Production database created\n- [ ] Migration run: &#96;npx prisma migrate deploy&#96;\n- [ ] Prisma client generated: &#96;npx prisma generate&#96;\n- [ ] Seed data loaded (if needed)\n- [ ] Database backups configured\n\n### Security\n- [ ] All secrets in environment variables (not in code)\n- [ ] HTTPS enabled\n- [ ] CORS configured correctly\n- [ ] Rate limiting configured\n- [ ] CSRF protection enabled (Next.js default)\n\n### PWA\n- [ ] &#96;manifest.json&#96; updated with production URL\n- [ ] Icons generated (192x192, 512x512)\n- [ ] Service worker tested\n- [ ] Offline functionality tested\n\n## Deployment Steps\n\n### 1. Build\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run build\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Test Build Locally\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm start\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. Deploy\n- Deploy to your hosting platform (Vercel, Render, etc.)\n- Set all environment variables\n- Run database migrations\n\n### 4. Post-Deployment\n\n#### Verify\n- [ ] Homepage loads\n- [ ] Login works",

        "contents": "Ei mingeid modal-hell’e\n\nCredit peab tunduma päris väärtusena\n\nKui UI on ilus, aga aeglane → vale.\n\n## 8) PWA REEGLID\n\nInstallitav\n\nNative share (mobile)\n\nOffline QR juba avatud voucheritele\n\niOS &amp; Android browser support\n\n## 9) LOGGING &amp; AUDIT\n\nKõik admin/staff tegevused → AuditLog\n\nÄra logi tundlikke andmeid\n\nRiskisündmused märgista (fraud flags)\n\n## 10) DONE DEFINITSIOON (ABSOLUUTNE)\n\nMVP on DONE, kui lokaalselt seed’iga:\n\nAvan voucheri\n\nLoon referral’i\n\nJagan linki\n\nFriend redeem’ib\n\nStaff kinnitab\n\nCredit tekib locked\n\nCredit unlock’itakse\n\nCredit kasutatakse demo checkout’is\n\nKui üks samm ei tööta → NOT DONE.\n\n## 11) KEEELUD (AUTOMAATNE STOPP)\n\nCursor EI TOHI:\n\nlisada uusi lehti\n\nlisada uusi rolle\n\nlisada uusi tasemeid\n\nlisada analytics’e “niisama”\n\n“parandada UX-i” scope’i laiendades\n\nKui tekib kiusatus → kirjuta V2 backlog’isse, ära ehita.\n\n## 12) BUILD ORDER (JÄRGI)\n\nPrisma schema + migrations\n\nAuth + RBAC + tenancy\n\nPublic voucher &amp; referral pages\n\nMerchant voucher builder\n\nRedemption + credit pipeline\n\nWallet UI\n\nPWA polish\n\nTests + seed + docs\n\n## 13) SUHTLUSREEGEL\n\nKui midagi on ebaselge → küsi\n\nKui miski ei mahu MVP-sse → ära tee\n\nKui reegel on vastuolus ideega → idee kaotab\n\n## 14) FILOSOOFIA\n\nSee projekt ei võida müraga.\nSee võidab selguse, distsipliini ja usaldusega.\n\nBuild infrastructure.\nNot hype.",

        "contents": "# Vouchr — Full Audit\n\n**Date:** 2025-01  \n**Scope:** Get project running; deps, scripts, auth, env, routes.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Package &amp; Scripts ✅\n\n| Script | Action |\n| --- | --- |\n| &#96;dev&#96; | next dev |\n| &#96;dev:full&#96; | scripts/dev-full.ps1: .env.local, Docker Postgres, db push, seed, ensure-test-user, dev |\n| &#96;db:setup&#96; | db:check, docker:up, wait 5s, db:wait, db:push, db:seed (no ensure-test-user) |\n| &#96;db:seed&#96; | tsx prisma/seed.ts |\n| &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96; | tsx prisma/ensure-test-user.ts ([test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) + Coffee House) |\n| &#96;db:push&#96; | prisma db push |\n\n- &#96;dev:full&#96; is the one-command path; requires Docker Desktop.\n- &#96;db:setup&#96; does not run &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96;; seed already upserts &#96;test@example.com&#96; and member.\n- **Seed on existing DB:** &#96;merchant.create&#96; etc. can fail with \"Unique constraint\" (e.g. &#96;slug&#96;). Run &#96;npm run db:ensure-test-user&#96;; test user and Coffee House are then ensured.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Auth ✅\n\n- **Credentials:** [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) / test123 (dev; from &#96;TEST_USER_EMAIL&#96;, &#96;TEST_USER_PASSWORD&#96; or defaults).\n- **Email:** magic link (needs SMTP in .env).\n- **OAuth:** Google, Apple (optional env).\n- **Session:** &#96;strategy: 'jwt'&#96; (required for Credentials).\n\n---\n\n## 3. Env\n\n| Var | Required | Notes |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; | yes | Local: &#96;postgresql://voucher_user:voucher_pass@localhost:5432/voucher_db&#96; |\n| &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96; | yes | min 32 chars |\n| &#96;NEXTAUTH_URL&#96; | optional | e.g. &lt;http://localhost:3000&gt; |\n| &#96;TEST_USER_EMAIL&#96; | no | default [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) (dev) |\n| &#96;TEST_USER_PASSWORD&#96; | no | default test123 (dev) |\n\n- &#96;dev:full&#96; overwrites &#96;.env.local&#96; with &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; and &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96;.\n- &#96;.env&#96; is used when &#96;.env.local&#96; is absent; ensure only one &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; (local Postgres).\n\n---\n\n## 4. Login &amp; /app ✅\n\n- **/login:** Credentials (e‑post+parool), magic link, Google, Apple. Test hint shown in dev.\n- **/app:** After login, lists user’s merchants (Wallet, Vouchers, Merchant Dashboard). [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) is &#96;merchant_admin&#96; for Coffee House (seed + ensure-test-user).\n\n---\n\n## 5. Docker &amp; DB ✅\n\n- **docker-compose.yml:** postgres (voucher_user, voucher_pass, voucher_db, 5432), redis.",

        "contents": "# Launch Mode Implementation Guide\n\nThis guide explains how to use the launch mode features (kill switch and feature flags) that have been prepared for the platform.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n1. Run the migration to add launch mode fields:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx prisma migrate dev --name launch_mode\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nOr manually apply the SQL from &#96;prisma/migrations/launch_mode/migration.sql&#96;\n\n2. Regenerate Prisma client:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx prisma generate\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Kill Switch\n\n### How It Works\n\nThe &#96;isActive&#96; field on the &#96;Merchant&#96; model acts as a kill switch. When set to &#96;false&#96;:\n- Merchant is hidden from public routes\n- New voucher creation is blocked\n- Existing redemptions can complete\n- All actions are logged to AuditLog\n\n### Usage\n\n#### Deactivate a Merchant\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { deactivateMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\n// Deactivate merchant (requires platform admin)\nawait deactivateMerchant(merchantId, actorUserId, 'Reason for deactivation');\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Activate a Merchant\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { activateMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\n// Activate merchant\nawait activateMerchant(merchantId, actorUserId);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Check Merchant Status in API Routes\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { requireActiveMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  // ... auth checks ...\n  \n  // Check merchant is active\n  await requireActiveMerchant(merchant.id);\n  \n  // Continue with voucher creation...\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### SQL Direct Access\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Deactivate merchant\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n\n-- Activate merchant\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = true WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n\n-- Check status\nSELECT id, name, \"isActive\" FROM \"Merchant\" WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Feature Flags\n\n### How It Works\n\nThe &#96;featureFlags&#96; JSON field on &#96;Merchant&#96; stores per-merchant feature flags. This allows enabling/disabling features per merchant without code changes.\n\n### Usage\n\n#### Check Feature Flag\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
