Allpool on loetletud poolikud funktsioonid, \"coming soon\" märgistused ja vajalikud täiendused.\n\n## 1. UI funktsioonid märgistatud \"Coming Soon\"\n\n### 1.1 Voucher redigeerimine\n**Asukoht:** &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]/page.tsx&#96;  \n**Olek:** Nupp on disabled, tekst \"Edit (Coming Soon)\"  \n**Vajalik:**\n- Voucher redigeerimise vorm (sarnane &#96;/vouchers/new&#96;)\n- PUT endpoint &#96;/api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; (olemas, vajab kontrolli)\n- Validatsioon ja error handling\n\n### 1.2 Liikmete kutsumine\n**Asukoht:** &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/members/page.tsx&#96;  \n**Olek:** Tekst \"Member invitation UI coming soon\"  \n**Vajalik:**\n- Kutsevorm (email + roll)\n- API endpoint liikmete lisamiseks\n- Email kutsed (Resend)\n- RBAC kontrollid (ainult merchant_admin)\n\n### 1.3 Platform admin funktsioonid\n**Asukoht:** &#96;app/admin/page.tsx&#96;  \n**Olek:** Tekst \"Platform admin features coming soon\"  \n**Vajalik:**\n- Merchant'ide aktiveerimine/deaktiveerimine UI\n- Feature flag'ide haldus\n- Audit log vaatamine\n- Statistika ja monitoring\n\n## 2. Testimine\n\n### 2.1 E2E testid\n**Olek:** Struktuur olemas, vajab täiendamist  \n**Failid:**\n- &#96;e2e/voucher-flow.spec.ts&#96;\n- &#96;e2e/auth.spec.ts&#96;\n- &#96;e2e/merchant-dashboard.spec.ts&#96;\n\n**Vajalik:**\n- Tegelikud test selector'id (praegu placeholder'id)\n- Täielikud flow'de testid (8 sammu done definition'ist)\n- Edge case'ide testid\n- Mobile viewport testid\n\n### 2.2 Test coverage\n**Olek:** API testid olemas, vajab täiendamist  \n**Vajalik:**\n- Rohkem unit test'e core business logic'ile\n- Integration testid email saatmisele\n- Stripe webhook testid\n\n## 3. Konfiguratsioon ja setup\n\n### 3.1 Production environment\n**Vajalikud env var'id:**\n- &#96;NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN&#96; (error tracking)\n- &#96;REDIS_URL&#96; (caching)\n- &#96;CRON_SECRET&#96; (cron job'ide jaoks)\n- SMTP/Resend konfiguratsioon\n- OAuth provider credentials (Google, Apple)\n\n### 3.2 Cron job'id\n**Olek:** Endpoint olemas (&#96;/api/cron/credit-expiry-warnings&#96;)  \n**Vajalik:**\n- Vercel Cron või väline cron teenus\n- Konfigureerimine iga päev käivituma\n- Testimine\n\n### 3.3 Database migrations\n**Olek:** Praegu kasutatakse &#96;db:push&#96;  \n**Vajalik:**\n- Teisendada migration'iteks production'iks\n- Loo esialgne migration: &#96;npx prisma migrate dev --name init&#96;\n- Migration rollback strateegia\n\n## 4. Täiustused (IDEAS.md / IMPROVEMENTS.md)\n\n### 4.1 Voucher otsing ja filtreerimine\n**Prioriteet:** Kõrge  \n**Vajalik:**\n- Otsing välja (headline, code prefix)\n- Filtreerimine: status, type, date range\n- Sortimine: date, name, redemptions\n- Pagination suurtele listidele\n\n### 4.2 QR code allalaadimine\n**Prioriteet:** Keskmine  \n**Vajalik:**\n- QR code allalaadimine PNG-na\n- Print-friendly voucher view\n- Shareable image generation\n\n### 4.3 Referral analytics\n**Prioriteet:** Keskmine  \n**Vajalik:**\n- Kui palju jagatud\n- Kui palju avatud\n- Conversion rate (opened → redeemed)\n- Top referrers\n- Referral timeline\n\n### 4.4 Voucher mallid\n**Prioriteet:** Madal  \n**Vajalik:**\n- Eeldefineeritud mallid\n- Custom mallide salvestamine\n- Kiire voucher'ite loomine mallidest\n\n### 4.5 Bulk operations\n**Prioriteet:** Madal  \n**Vajalik:**\n- Mitme voucher'i korraga avaldamine/pausimine\n- CSV import vouchers\n- Bulk delete\n\n## 5. V2 funktsioonid (dokumenteeritud, aga mitte implementeeritud)\n\nNeed on dokumenteeritud &#96;docs/V2_BACKLOG.md&#96;'s, aga **EI TOHI** MVP-sse ehitada:\n\n1. **Apple Wallet / Google Wallet** - Voucher'ite lisamine native wallet app'idesse\n2. **Push Notifications** - In-app notifications (email on olemas)\n3. **Multi-language Selector** - User-selectable language (praegu browser detection)\n4. **Custom Domains** - Merchant-branded domains\n5. **POS Deep Integrations** - Direct POS system integration\n6. **Analytics Exports (PDF)** - CSV on olemas, PDF puudub\n7. **White-label Mode** - Fully branded merchant experience\n\n## 6. Dokumentatsioon\n\n### 6.1 Puuduvad või vajavad täiendamist\n- **API dokumentatsioon:** &#96;docs/API.md&#96; on olemas, vajab täiendamist\n- **Deployment guide:** &#96;docs/DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md&#96; on olemas\n- **Troubleshooting:** &#96;docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md&#96; on olemas\n\n### 6.2 Vajalikud täiendused\n- Production deployment step-by-step guide\n- Monitoring setup guide (Sentry, uptime)\n- Backup restoration guide\n\n## 7. Security ja compliance\n\n### 7.1 Security headers\n**Olek:** &#96;docs/SECURITY_CHECKLIST.md&#96; on olemas  \n**Vajalik:**\n- Implementeerida security header'id &#96;next.config.js&#96;'is\n- CSP konfiguratsioon\n- HSTS, X-Frame-Options, jne\n\n### 7.2 Audit log täiendused\n**Olek:** AuditLog model on olemas  \n**Vajalik:**\n- Veenduda, et kõik kriitilised tegevused on logitud\n- Audit log review UI (platform admin'ile)\n\n## 8. Performance\n\n### 8.1 Caching\n**Olek:** &#96;lib/cache.ts&#96; on olemas  \n**Vajalik:**\n- Redis setup production'is\n- Cache invalidation strateegia testimine\n- Public voucher page caching\n\n### 8.2 Image optimization\n**Olek:** Next.js Image komponent kasutamata  \n**Vajalik:**\n- Brand logo'de optimeerimine\n- QR code'ide optimeerimine\n\n## Prioriteedid\n\n### Kõrge prioriteet (enne tootmist)\n1. ✅ Voucher redigeerimine\n2. ✅ Liikmete kutsumine\n3. ✅ E2E testide täiendamine\n4. ✅ Production environment setup\n5. ✅ Database migrations\n6. ✅ Security headers\n\n### Keskmine prioriteet (pärast MVP launch'i)\n1. Voucher otsing ja filtreerimine\n2. QR code allalaadimine\n3. Referral analytics\n4. Platform admin UI\n\n### Madal prioriteet (V2)\n1. Voucher mallid\n2. Bulk operations\n3. Voucher kategooriad\n4. Advanced analytics\n\n## Järgmised sammud\n\n1. **Kontrolli MVP compliance:** Veendu, et kõik 8 sammu &#96;TESTING_GUIDE.md&#96;'st töötavad\n2. **Täienda \"Coming Soon\" funktsioone:** Voucher edit, member invites, platform admin\n3. **Seadista production:** Environment variables, Redis, Sentry, cron jobs\n4. **Täienda teste:** E2E testid, coverage\n5. **Security audit:** Implementeeri security headers, veendu audit log'ides\n\n## Märkused\n\n- MVP on ~95% valmis\n- Kõik core flow'd (A-F) on implementeeritud\n- Peamised puudused on UI polish'is ja testides\n- V2 funktsioonid on dokumenteeritud, aga **EI TOHI** MVP-sse ehitada\n- Projekt on valmis launch mode'iks, kui production setup on tehtud",

        "range": {

          "endPosition": {
            "line": 69

        "contents": "# Launch Mode Configuration\n\nPer specification section 15, the platform is prepared for **invite-only merchants** with **manual onboarding**.\n\n## Current Implementation\n\n### Platform Admin\n- **Route**: &#96;/admin&#96;\n- **Access**: Environment variable &#96;PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS&#96;\n- **Purpose**: Manual merchant onboarding and monitoring\n- **Status**: Minimal implementation (ready for expansion)\n\n### Merchant Member Management\n- **Route**: &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;\n- **Access**: Merchant admin only\n- **Purpose**: Add/remove merchant staff\n- **Status**: Basic UI (add via database/API for now)\n\n## Feature Flags (To Implement)\n\nThe specification requires:\n- Feature flags per merchant\n- Kill switch per merchant\n- Invite-only merchant signup\n\n### Recommended Implementation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Add to Merchant model\nmodel Merchant {\n  // ... existing fields\n  isActive      Boolean @default(true)  // Kill switch\n  featureFlags  Json?                   // Per-merchant feature flags\n  invitedAt    DateTime?                // Track manual invites\n  onboardedAt  DateTime?                // Track onboarding completion\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Feature Flag Examples\n- &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;customDomainsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;analyticsEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n- &#96;whiteLabelEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n\n## Manual Onboarding Flow\n\n1. **Platform admin** creates merchant via database/API\n2. **Platform admin** adds merchant admin user via &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; or database\n3. **Merchant admin** receives invite email (to implement)\n4. **Merchant admin** logs in and completes onboarding\n5. **Merchant** can start creating vouchers\n\n## Kill Switch\n\nTo disable a merchant:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis should:\n- Hide merchant from public routes\n- Prevent new voucher creation\n- Allow existing redemptions to complete\n- Log action in AuditLog\n\n## No Public Signup\n\n- ✅ No public merchant signup form\n- ✅ No public user registration (except via OAuth/magic link)",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "5. **Redemption Creation** (&#96;app/api/redemptions/route.ts&#96;)\n   - Allow existing redemptions, but log warning\n\n### Where to Add Feature Flag Checks\n\nAdd feature flag checks to:\n\n1. **Weekly Drop Claim** (&#96;app/api/weekly-drop/claim/route.ts&#96;)\n   - Check &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled&#96; flag\n\n2. **Voucher Builder** (&#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new/page.tsx&#96;)\n   - Show/hide weekly drop options based on flag\n\n3. **Analytics Dashboard** (&#96;app/merchant/[slug]/analytics/page.tsx&#96;)\n   - Check &#96;analyticsEnabled&#96; flag (V2)\n\n## Manual Onboarding Flow\n\n### Step 1: Create Merchant\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nINSERT INTO \"Merchant\" (id, name, slug, country, \"defaultCurrency\", \"isActive\", \"invitedAt\")\nVALUES (\n  gen_random_uuid()::text,\n  'New Merchant',\n  'new-merchant',\n  'US',\n  'USD',\n  true,\n  NOW()\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 2: Add Merchant Admin\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- First, create or find user\nINSERT INTO \"User\" (id, email, name, \"emailVerified\")\nVALUES (gen_random_uuid()::text, 'admin@new-merchant.com', 'Admin', NOW())\nON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING;\n\n-- Add as merchant admin\nINSERT INTO \"MerchantMember\" (id, \"merchantId\", \"userId\", role)\nVALUES (\n  gen_random_uuid()::text,\n  (SELECT id FROM \"Merchant\" WHERE slug = 'new-merchant'),\n  (SELECT id FROM \"User\" WHERE email = 'admin@new-merchant.com'),\n  'merchant_admin'\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: Mark Onboarded\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" \nSET \"onboardedAt\" = NOW()\nWHERE \"slug\" = 'new-merchant';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Monitoring\n\n### Check Merchant Status\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nSELECT \n  name,\n  slug,\n  \"isActive\",\n  \"invitedAt\",\n  \"onboardedAt\",\n  \"featureFlags\"\nFROM \"Merchant\"\nORDER BY \"createdAt\" DESC;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Audit Log\n\nAll kill switch actions are logged:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nSELECT \n  \"createdAt\",\n  action,\n  \"payloadJson\"\nFROM \"AuditLog\"\nWHERE action IN ('merchant_activated', 'merchant_deactivated')\nORDER BY \"createdAt\" DESC;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Best Practices\n\n1. **Always check &#96;isActive&#96; before allowing writes** - Prevents creating vouchers for inactive merchants\n2. **Log all kill switch actions** - Use &#96;deactivateMerchant()&#96; and &#96;activateMerchant()&#96; functions",

        "contents": "const createVoucherSchema = \n\n  designJson: z.any().optional(),\n  codePrefix: z.string().optional(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { slug: string } }\n) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n      where: { slug: params.slug },\n    });\n\n    if (!merchant) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    await requireActiveMerchant(merchant.id);\n    await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_admin');\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const data = createVoucherSchema.parse(body);\n\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.create({\n      data: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        status: 'draft',\n        ...data,\n        validFrom: new Date(data.validFrom),\n        validTo: new Date(data.validTo),\n        weeklyDropJson: data.weeklyDropJson ? JSON.stringify(data.designJson) : Prisma.DbNull,\n      },\n    });\n\n    return NextResponse.json(voucher);\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    console.error('Error creating voucher:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Activate merchant\n * Logs action to audit log\n */\nexport async function activateMerchant(\n  merchantId: string,\n  actorUserId: string\n): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n  await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) =&gt; {\n    // Activate merchant\n    await tx.merchant.update({\n      where: { id: merchantId },\n      data: { isActive: true },\n    });\n\n    // Log to audit\n    await tx.auditLog.create({\n      data: {\n        merchantId,\n        actorUserId,\n        action: 'merchant_activated',\n      },\n    });\n  });\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { hashFriendIdentifier } from '@/lib/utils';\nimport { checkReferralRateLimit } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createReferralSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  friendHint: z.string().optional(), // optional identifier hint for friend\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const { voucherId, friendHint } = createReferralSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not available' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check rate limit\n    const rateLimit = await checkReferralRateLimit(session.user.id);\n    if (!rateLimit.allowed) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: rateLimit.remaining },\n        { status: 429 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Hash friend identifier if provided\n    const friendHash = friendHint\n      ? await hashFriendIdentifier(friendHint)\n      : &#96;anonymous_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}&#96;;\n\n    // Create referral\n    const referral = await prisma.referral.create({\n      data: {\n        voucherId: voucher.id,\n        merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n        referrerUserId: session.user.id,\n        friendHash,\n        status: 'created',\n      },\n    });\n\n    // Generate share URL\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${referral.id}&#96;;\n\n    return NextResponse.json\n\n}",

        "contents": "- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/generate-tickets&#96; - Generate tickets for event\n\n### Tickets\n\n- &#96;POST /api/tickets/[id]/purchase&#96; - Purchase ticket (Stripe checkout)\n\n### Referrals\n\n- &#96;POST /api/referrals/create&#96; - Create referral and get share URL\n\n### Redemptions\n\n- &#96;POST /api/redemptions&#96; - Create redemption\n- &#96;POST /api/redemptions/[id]/confirm&#96; - Confirm redemption (staff)\n\n### Credits\n\n- &#96;GET /api/wallet/[merchantSlug]&#96; - Get credit balance\n- &#96;POST /api/credits/apply&#96; - Apply credit to order\n\n### Weekly Drop\n\n- &#96;POST /api/weekly-drop/claim&#96; - Claim weekly drop stock\n\n## Database Schema\n\nKey models:\n\n- &#96;Merchant&#96;: Tenant information\n- &#96;User&#96;: Platform users\n- &#96;MerchantMember&#96;: User-merchant relationships with roles\n- &#96;Voucher&#96;: Voucher definitions\n- &#96;Campaign&#96;: Campaign definitions (pricing, limits, credit percentages)\n- &#96;VoucherPurchase&#96;: Voucher purchase records\n- &#96;Event&#96;: Event definitions\n- &#96;Ticket&#96;: Ticket instances for events\n- &#96;TicketPurchase&#96;: Ticket purchase records\n- &#96;Referral&#96;: Referral instances\n- &#96;Redemption&#96;: Redemption records\n- &#96;CreditLedger&#96;: Credit transactions\n- &#96;CreditUsage&#96;: Credit application records\n- &#96;AuditLog&#96;: Audit trail\n\nSee &#96;prisma/schema.prisma&#96; for full schema.\n\n## Business Rules\n\n1. **Credit is NOT cash**: Cannot be transferred or withdrawn\n2. **Per-merchant credits**: Credits are merchant-specific\n3. **Credit expiration**: Default 60 days (configurable per merchant)\n4. **Self-referral prevention**: Users cannot redeem their own referrals\n5. **Credit locking**: Credits start as LOCKED, unlock after redemption confirmation\n6. **Weekly drop stock**: Enforced atomically\n7. **Usage limits**: Total and per-user limits enforced\n\n## Testing\n\nRun tests:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm test\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Deployment\n\n### Environment Variables",

        "contents": "# Launch Mode Implementation Guide\n\nThis guide explains how to use the launch mode features (kill switch and feature flags) that have been prepared for the platform.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n1. Run the migration to add launch mode fields:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx prisma migrate dev --name launch_mode\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nOr manually apply the SQL from &#96;prisma/migrations/launch_mode/migration.sql&#96;\n\n2. Regenerate Prisma client:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx prisma generate\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Kill Switch\n\n### How It Works\n\nThe &#96;isActive&#96; field on the &#96;Merchant&#96; model acts as a kill switch. When set to &#96;false&#96;:\n- Merchant is hidden from public routes\n- New voucher creation is blocked\n- Existing redemptions can complete\n- All actions are logged to AuditLog\n\n### Usage\n\n#### Deactivate a Merchant\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { deactivateMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\n// Deactivate merchant (requires platform admin)\nawait deactivateMerchant(merchantId, actorUserId, 'Reason for deactivation');\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Activate a Merchant\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { activateMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\n// Activate merchant\nawait activateMerchant(merchantId, actorUserId);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Check Merchant Status in API Routes\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { requireActiveMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  // ... auth checks ...\n  \n  // Check merchant is active\n  await requireActiveMerchant(merchant.id);\n  \n  // Continue with voucher creation...\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### SQL Direct Access\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Deactivate merchant\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n\n-- Activate merchant\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = true WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n\n-- Check status\nSELECT id, name, \"isActive\" FROM \"Merchant\" WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Feature Flags\n\n### How It Works\n\nThe &#96;featureFlags&#96; JSON field on &#96;Merchant&#96; stores per-merchant feature flags. This allows enabling/disabling features per merchant without code changes.\n\n### Usage\n\n#### Check Feature Flag\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Launch Mode Implementation Guide",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "This guide explains how to use the launch mode features (kill switch and feature flags) that have been prepared for the platform.",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "## Prerequisites",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Run the migration to add launch mode fields:",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "npx prisma migrate dev --name launch_mode",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "Or manually apply the SQL from &#96;prisma/migrations/launch_mode/migration.sql&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Regenerate Prisma client:",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "npx prisma generate",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "## Kill Switch",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "### How It Works",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "The &#96;isActive&#96; field on the &#96;Merchant&#96; model acts as a kill switch. When set to &#96;false&#96;:",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- Merchant is hidden from public routes",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "- New voucher creation is blocked",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "- Existing redemptions can complete",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- All actions are logged to AuditLog",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "### Usage",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Deactivate a Merchant",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "import { deactivateMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "// Deactivate merchant (requires platform admin)",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "await deactivateMerchant(merchantId, actorUserId, 'Reason for deactivation');",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Activate a Merchant",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "import { activateMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "// Activate merchant",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "await activateMerchant(merchantId, actorUserId);",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Check Merchant Status in API Routes",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "import { requireActiveMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "  // ... auth checks ...",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "  ",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "  // Check merchant is active",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "  await requireActiveMerchant(merchant.id);",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "  ",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "  // Continue with voucher creation...",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "#### SQL Direct Access",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "-- Deactivate merchant",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "UPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "-- Activate merchant",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "UPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = true WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "-- Check status",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "SELECT id, name, \"isActive\" FROM \"Merchant\" WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "## Feature Flags",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "### How It Works",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "The &#96;featureFlags&#96; JSON field on &#96;Merchant&#96; stores per-merchant feature flags. This allows enabling/disabling features per merchant without code changes.",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "### Usage",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Check Feature Flag",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 87
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.22581300139427185
    },

        "contents": "- **/app:** After login, lists user’s merchants (Wallet, Vouchers, Merchant Dashboard). [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) is &#96;merchant_admin&#96; for Coffee House (seed + ensure-test-user).\n\n---\n\n## 5. Docker &amp; DB ✅\n\n- **docker-compose.yml:** postgres (voucher_user, voucher_pass, voucher_db, 5432), redis.\n- **wait-for-db.ps1:** TcpClient to &#96;127.0.0.1:5432&#96;.\n- **dev:full:** &#96;docker compose up -d postgres&#96;, then wait-for-db, db push, seed, ensure-test-user.\n\n---\n\n## 6. Seed ✅\n\n- Merchants: Coffee House, Tech Store.\n- Users: [admin@coffee-house.com](mailto:admin@coffee-house.com), [user@example.com](mailto:user@example.com), [**test@example.com**](mailto:test@example.com) (upsert).\n- [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) is member of Coffee House (merchant_admin).\n- Vouchers, referral, redemption, credit, audit log.\n\n---\n\n## 7. Known / Non-blocking\n\n- **next-intl:** &#96;getRequestConfig&#96; &#96;locale&#96; is deprecated in favor of &#96;requestLocale&#96;; non-blocking.\n- **i18n:** &#96;getRequestConfig&#96; must return &#96;locale&#96;; next major may require it.\n\n---\n\n## 8.         "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\nconst ;\n        if (!rateLimit.allowed) {\n          return NextResponse.json(\n            { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: rateLimit.remaining },\n            { status: 429 }\n          );\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Create redemption (unconfirmed initially)\n    const redemption = await prisma.redemption.create({\n      data: {\n        voucherId: voucher.id,\n        merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n        referralId: data.referralId,\n        redeemedByUserId: session?.user?.id || null,\n        method: data.method,\n        orderReference: data.orderReference,\n        amountBeforeDiscount: data.amountBeforeDiscount,\n        discountApplied: data.discountApplied,\n        currency: data.currency,\n        confirmedAt: null,\n      },\n    });\n\n    // If there's a referral, create locked credit\n    if (data.referralId) {\n      const referral = await prisma.referral.findUnique({\n        where: { id: data.referralId },\n        include: { referrer: true },\n      });\n\n      if (referral) {\n        // Calculate credit amount (for MVP, use a fixed percentage or voucher value)\n        let creditAmount = 0;\n        if (voucher.type === 'credit_amount') {\n          creditAmount = voucher.value;\n        } else if (voucher.type === 'fixed_amount') {\n          creditAmount = voucher.value; // Same as discount\n        } else {\n          // Percentage: give 10% of discount as credit (configurable)\n          creditAmount = Math.floor(data.discountApplied * 0.1);\n        }\n\n        if (creditAmount &gt; 0) {\n          const expiresAt = new Date();\n          expiresAt.setDate(expiresAt.getDate() + 60); // Default 60 days\n\n          await prisma.creditLedger.create({\n            data: {\n              merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n              userId: referral.referrerUserId,\n              amount: creditAmount,\n              currency: voucher.currency,\n              status: 'locked',\n              source: 'referral_redemption',\n              sourceId: redemption.id,\n              expiresAt,\n            },\n          });\n\n          // Update referral status\n          await\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Check if user has a specific role for a merchant\n */\nexport async function hasMerchantRole(\n  userId: string,\n  merchantId: string,\n  requiredRole: 'merchant_admin' | 'merchant_staff'\n): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  const member = await prisma.merchantMember.findUnique({\n    where: {\n      merchantId_userId: {\n        merchantId,\n        userId,\n      },\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (!member) return false;\n\n  if (requiredRole === 'merchant_admin') {\n    return member.role === 'merchant_admin';\n  }\n\n  // merchant_staff can access merchant_staff routes, merchant_admin can access both\n  return member.role === 'merchant_admin' || member.role === 'merchant_staff';\n}\n\n/**\n * Check if user is platform admin\n * For now, we'll use a simple env-based check.         "contents": "# Launch Mode Configuration\n\nPer specification section 15, the platform is prepared for **invite-only merchants** with **manual onboarding**.\n\n## Current Implementation\n\n### Platform Admin\n- **Route**: &#96;/admin&#96;\n- **Access**: Environment variable &#96;PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS&#96;\n- **Purpose**: Manual merchant onboarding and monitoring\n- **Status**: Minimal implementation (ready for expansion)\n\n### Merchant Member Management\n- **Route**: &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;\n- **Access**: Merchant admin only\n- **Purpose**: Add/remove merchant staff\n- **Status**: Basic UI (add via database/API for now)\n\n## Feature Flags (To Implement)\n\nThe specification requires:\n- Feature flags per merchant\n- Kill switch per merchant\n- Invite-only merchant signup\n\n### Recommended Implementation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Add to Merchant model\nmodel Merchant {\n  // ... existing fields\n  isActive      Boolean @default(true)  // Kill switch\n  featureFlags  Json?                   // Per-merchant feature flags\n  invitedAt    DateTime?                // Track manual invites\n  onboardedAt  DateTime?                // Track onboarding completion\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Feature Flag Examples\n- &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;customDomainsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;analyticsEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n- &#96;whiteLabelEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n\n## Manual Onboarding Flow\n\n1. **Platform admin** creates merchant via database/API\n2. **Platform admin** adds merchant admin user via &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; or database\n3. **Merchant admin** receives invite email (to implement)\n4. **Merchant admin** logs in and completes onboarding\n5. **Merchant** can start creating vouchers\n\n## Kill Switch\n\nTo disable a merchant:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis should:\n- Hide merchant from public routes\n- Prevent new voucher creation\n- Allow existing redemptions to complete\n- Log action in AuditLog\n\n## No Public Signup\n\n- ✅ No public merchant signup form\n- ✅ No public user registration (except via OAuth/magic link)",

            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "  // ... existing fields",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "  isActive      Boolean @default(true)  // Kill switch",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "  featureFlags  Json?                   // Per-merchant feature flags",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "  invitedAt    DateTime?                // Track manual invites",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "### Feature Flag Examples",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled: boolean&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;customDomainsEnabled: boolean&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;analyticsEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;whiteLabelEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "## Manual Onboarding Flow",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Platform admin** creates merchant via database/API",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Platform admin** adds merchant admin user via &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; or database",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Merchant admin** receives invite email (to implement)",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **Merchant admin** logs in and completes onboarding",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "5. **Merchant** can start creating vouchers",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "## Kill Switch",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "To disable a merchant:",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "UPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "This should:",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "- Hide merchant from public routes",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "- Prevent new voucher creation",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "- Allow existing redemptions to complete",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "- Log action in AuditLog",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "## No Public Signup",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ No public merchant signup form",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ No public user registration (except via OAuth/magic link)",
            "lineNumber": 69
          }
        ]
      },

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp; vouchers\n\n### MVP UI Scope\n**PUBLIC:**\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page\n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n**USER:**\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo\n\n**MERCHANT:**\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n**Non-MVP (Documented):**\n- &#96;/admin&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; - Public merchant page (should be removed per spec)\n\n### UI Look &amp; Feel\n- ✅ Premium, calm, confident design\n- ✅ Mobile-first responsive\n- ✅ One primary CTA per screen\n- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s",

        "contents": "// This is your Prisma schema file,\n// learn more about it in the docs: https://pris.ly/d/prisma-schema\n\ngenerator client {\n  provider = \"prisma-client-js\"\n}\n\ndatasource db {\n  provider = \"postgresql\"\n  url      = env(\"DATABASE_URL\")\n}\n\nmodel Account {\n  id                String  @id @default(cuid())\n  userId            String\n  type              String\n  provider          String\n  providerAccountId String\n  refresh_token     String? @db.Text\n  access_token      String? @db.Text\n  expires_at        Int?\n  token_type        String?\n  scope             String?\n  id_token          String? @db.Text\n  session_state     String?\n\n  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@unique([provider, providerAccountId])\n  @@index([userId])\n}\n\nmodel Session {\n  id           String   @id @default(cuid())\n  sessionToken String   @unique\n  userId       String\n  expires      DateTime\n  user         User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@index([userId])\n}\n\nmodel VerificationToken {\n  identifier String\n  token      String   @unique\n  expires    DateTime\n\n  @@unique([identifier, token])\n}\n\nmodel User {\n  id            String    @id @default(cuid())\n  email         String    @unique\n  emailVerified DateTime?\n  name          String?\n  image         String?\n  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())\n  updatedAt     DateTime  @updatedAt\n\n  accounts         Account[]\n  sessions         Session[]\n  merchantMembers  MerchantMember[]\n  referrals        Referral[]         @relation(\"Referrer\")\n  redemptions      Redemption[]        @relation(\"RedeemedBy\")\n  staffRedemptions Redemption[]        @relation(\"RedeemedByStaff\")\n  creditLedgers    CreditLedger[]\n  creditUsages     CreditUsage[]\n  voucherPurchases VoucherPurchase[]\n  ticketPurchases  TicketPurchase[]\n  auditLogs        AuditLog[]\n}\n\nmodel Merchant {\n  ",

'test123' : '');\n\nexport const { handlers, auth, signIn, signOut } = NextAuth({\n  adapter: PrismaAdapter(prisma),\n  providers: [\n    Credentials({\n      credentials: {\n        email: { label: 'Email', type: 'email' },\n        password: { label: 'Password', type: 'password' },\n      },\n      async authorize(credentials) {\n        if (!credentials?.email || typeof credentials.email !== 'string' || !credentials?.password || typeof credentials.password !== 'string') return null;\n        if (!testEmail || !testPassword) return null;\n        if (credentials.email !== testEmail || credentials.password !== testPassword) return null;\n        let user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email: testEmail } });\n        if (!user) {\n          user = await prisma.user.create({ data: { email: testEmail, name: 'Test User' } });\n        }\n        return { id: user.id, email: user.email, name: user.name ??         "contents": "5. **Redemption Creation** (&#96;app/api/redemptions/route.ts&#96;)\n   - Allow existing redemptions, but log warning\n\n### Where to Add Feature Flag Checks\n\nAdd feature flag checks to:\n\n1. **Weekly Drop Claim** (&#96;app/api/weekly-drop/claim/route.ts&#96;)\n   - Check &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled&#96; flag\n\n2. **Voucher Builder** (&#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new/page.tsx&#96;)\n   - Show/hide weekly drop options based on flag\n\n3. **Analytics Dashboard** (&#96;app/merchant/[slug]/analytics/page.tsx&#96;)\n   - Check &#96;analyticsEnabled&#96; flag (V2)\n\n## Manual Onboarding Flow\n\n### Step 1: Create Merchant\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nINSERT INTO \"Merchant\" (id, name, slug, country, \"defaultCurrency\", \"isActive\", \"invitedAt\")\nVALUES (\n  gen_random_uuid()::text,\n  'New Merchant',\n  'new-merchant',\n  'US',\n  'USD',\n  true,\n  NOW()\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 2: Add Merchant Admin\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- First, create or find user\nINSERT INTO \"User\" (id, email, name, \"emailVerified\")\nVALUES (gen_random_uuid()::text, 'admin@new-merchant.com', 'Admin', NOW())\nON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING;\n\n-- Add as merchant admin\nINSERT INTO \"MerchantMember\" (id, \"merchantId\", \"userId\", role)\nVALUES (\n  gen_random_uuid()::text,\n  (SELECT id FROM \"Merchant\" WHERE slug = 'new-merchant'),\n  (SELECT id FROM \"User\" WHERE email = 'admin@new-merchant.com'),\n  'merchant_admin'\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: Mark Onboarded\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" \nSET \"onboardedAt\" = NOW()\nWHERE \"slug\" = 'new-merchant';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Monitoring\n\n### Check Merchant Status\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nSELECT \n  name,\n  slug,\n  \"isActive\",\n  \"invitedAt\",\n  \"onboardedAt\",\n  \"featureFlags\"\nFROM \"Merchant\"\nORDER BY \"createdAt\" DESC;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Audit Log\n\nAll kill switch actions are logged:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nSELECT \n  \"createdAt\",\n  action,\n  \"payloadJson\"\nFROM \"AuditLog\"\nWHERE action IN ('merchant_activated', 'merchant_deactivated')\nORDER BY \"createdAt\" DESC;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Best Practices\n\n1. **Always check &#96;isActive&#96; before allowing writes** - Prevents creating vouchers for inactive merchants\n2. **Log all kill switch actions** - Use &#96;deactivateMerchant()&#96; and &#96;activateMerchant()&#96; functions",

          },

            "lineNumber": 208
          },
          {
            "text": "## Monitoring",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 210
          },

            "text": "### Check Merchant Status",

          },

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 238
          },

        "contents": "# Launch Mode Implementation Guide\n\nThis guide explains how to use the launch mode features (kill switch and feature flags) that have been prepared for the platform.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n1. Run the migration to add launch mode fields:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx prisma migrate dev --name launch_mode\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nOr manually apply the SQL from &#96;prisma/migrations/launch_mode/migration.sql&#96;\n\n2. Regenerate Prisma client:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx prisma generate\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Kill Switch\n\n### How It Works\n\nThe &#96;isActive&#96; field on the &#96;Merchant&#96; model acts as a kill switch. When set to &#96;false&#96;:\n- Merchant is hidden from public routes\n- New voucher creation is blocked\n- Existing redemptions can complete\n- All actions are logged to AuditLog\n\n### Usage\n\n#### Deactivate a Merchant\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { deactivateMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\n// Deactivate merchant (requires platform admin)\nawait deactivateMerchant(merchantId, actorUserId, 'Reason for deactivation');\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Activate a Merchant\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { activateMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\n// Activate merchant\nawait activateMerchant(merchantId, actorUserId);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Check Merchant Status in API Routes\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { requireActiveMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  // ... auth checks ...\n  \n  // Check merchant is active\n  await requireActiveMerchant(merchant.id);\n  \n  // Continue with voucher creation...\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### SQL Direct Access\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Deactivate merchant\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n\n-- Activate merchant\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = true WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n\n-- Check status\nSELECT id, name, \"isActive\" FROM \"Merchant\" WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Feature Flags\n\n### How It Works\n\nThe &#96;featureFlags&#96; JSON field on &#96;Merchant&#96; stores per-merchant feature flags. This allows enabling/disabling features per merchant without code changes.\n\n### Usage\n\n#### Check Feature Flag\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",

        "contents": "import { prisma } from './prisma';\nimport { NotFoundError, ForbiddenError } from './errors';\n\n/**\n * Check if merchant is active (kill switch)\n */\nexport async function isMerchantActive(merchantId: string): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n    where: { id: merchantId },\n    select: { isActive: true },\n  });\n\n  if (!merchant) {\n    throw new NotFoundError('Merchant not found');\n  }\n\n  return merchant.isActive ?? true; // Default to true if column doesn't exist yet\n}\n\n/**\n * Require merchant to be active, throw if inactive\n */\nexport async function requireActiveMerchant(merchantId: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n  const active = await isMerchantActive(merchantId);\n}",

        "contents": "export async function POST(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { slug: string } }\n) {\n\n  }\n}\n\nexport async function GET(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { slug: string } }\n) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n      where: { slug: params.slug },\n    });\n\n    if (!merchant) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    // If authenticated and has merchant role, show all vouchers\n    // Otherwise, show only published vouchers\n    const where: {\n      merchantId: string;\n      status?: string;\n    } = { merchantId: merchant.id };\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      where.status = 'published';\n    } else {\n      try {\n        await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_staff');\n      } catch {\n        where.status = 'published';\n      }\n    }\n\n    const vouchers = await prisma.voucher.findMany({\n      where,\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    });\n\n    return NextResponse.json(vouchers);\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error fetching vouchers:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

redirect('/login');\n\n  const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({ where: { slug: params.slug } });\n  if (!merchant) notFound();\n\n  await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_staff');\n\n  const now = new Date();\n  const dayStart = startOfDay(now);\n  const weekStart = startOfWeek(now, { weekStartsOn: 1 });\n\n  const [\n    activeVouchers,\n    activeCampaigns,\n    activeEvents,\n    redemptionsToday,\n    redemptionsThisWeek,\n    redemptionCount,\n    pendingRedemptions,\n    totalCreditsIssued,\n    totalRevenue,\n    outstandingLiability,\n    ticketRevenue,\n    ticketsSold,\n  ] = await Promise.all([\n    prisma.voucher.count({ where: { merchantId: merchant.id, status: 'published' } }),\n    prisma.campaign.count({ where: { merchantId: merchant.id, status: 'active' } }),\n    prisma.event.count({ where: { merchantId: merchant.id, status: 'published' } }),\n    prisma.redemption.count({\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id, createdAt: { gte: dayStart } },\n    }),\n    prisma.redemption.count({\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id, createdAt: { gte: weekStart } },\n    }),\n    prisma.redemption.count({\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id, confirmedAt: { not: null } },\n    }),\n    prisma.redemption.count({\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id, confirmedAt: null },\n prisma.voucherPurchase.aggregate\n\n;\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { requireMerchantRole } from '@/lib/rbac';\nimport { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';\nimport { formatCurrency } from '@/lib/utils';\n\nexport default async function AnalyticsPage({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {\n  const session = await auth();\n  if (!session?.user?.id) {\n    redirect('/login');\n  }\n\n  const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n    where: { slug: params.slug },\n  });\n\n  if (!merchant) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_staff');\n\n  // Get analytics data\n  const [\n    totalRedemptions,\n    totalRevenue,\n    totalCreditsIssued,\n    topVouchers,\n    recentRedemptions,\n  ] = await Promise.all([\n    prisma.redemption.count({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        confirmedAt: { not: null },\n      },\n    }),\n    prisma.redemption.aggregate({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        confirmedAt: { not: null },\n      },\n      _sum: {\n        discountApplied: true,\n      },\n    }),\n    prisma.creditLedger.aggregate({\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id },\n      _sum: { amount: true },\n    }),\n    prisma.voucher.findMany({\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id },\n      include: {\n        _count: {\n          select: {\n            redemptions: {\n              where: { confirmedAt: { not: null } },\n            },\n          },\n        },\n      },\n      orderBy: {\n        redemptions: {\n          _count: 'desc',\n        },\n      },\n      take: 5,\n    }),\n    prisma.redemption.findMany({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        confirmedAt: { not: null },\n      },\n      include: {\n        voucher: {\n          select: { id: true, type: true },\n        },\n      },\n      orderBy: { confirmedAt: 'desc' },\n      take: 10,\n    }),\n  ]);\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"p-4 sm:p-6\"&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { requireMerchantRole } from '@/lib/rbac';\nimport { formatCurrency } from '@/lib/utils';\nimport { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';\nimport { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';\nimport ConfirmRedemptionButton from './confirm-button';\nimport ExportRedemptionsButton from './export-button';\nimport Breadcrumbs from '@/components/navigation/breadcrumbs';\nimport { getTranslations } from 'next-intl/server';\nimport { CheckCircle } from 'lucide-react';\n\nexport default async function RedemptionsPage({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {\n  const session = await auth();\n  if (!session?.user?.id) {\n    redirect('/login');\n  }\n\n  const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n    where: { slug: params.slug },\n  });\n\n  if (!merchant) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_staff');\n\n  const t = await getTranslations('nav');\n  const tRedemption = await getTranslations('redemption');\n\n  const redemptions = await prisma.redemption.findMany({\n    where: { merchantId: merchant.id },\n    include: {\n      voucher: true,\n      referral: {\n        include: {\n          referrer: {\n            select: { name: true, email: true },\n          },\n        },\n      },\n    },\n    orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    take: 50,\n  });\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { requireMerchantRole } from '@/lib/rbac';\nimport { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';\nimport { formatCurrency } from '@/lib/utils';\n\nexport default async function ReferralsPage({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {\n  const session = await auth();\n  if (!session?.user?.id) {\n    redirect('/login');\n  }\n\n  const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n    where: { slug: params.slug },\n  });\n\n  if (!merchant) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_staff');\n\n  // Get referral analytics\n  const [\n    totalReferrals,\n    openedReferrals,\n    redeemedReferrals,\n    topReferrers,\n    referralStats,\n  ] = await Promise.all([\n    prisma.referral.count({\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id },\n    }),\n    prisma.referral.count({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        status: { in: ['opened', 'redeemed'] },\n      },\n    }),\n    prisma.referral.count({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        status: 'redeemed',\n      },\n    }),\n    prisma.referral.groupBy({\n      by: ['referrerUserId'],\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id },\n      _count: { id: true },\n      orderBy: { _count: { id: 'desc' } },\n      take: 10,\n    }),\n    prisma.referral.groupBy({\n      by: ['status'],\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id },\n      _count: { id: true },\n    }),\n  ]);\n\n  // Get user details for top referrers\n  const topReferrerIds = topReferrers.map((r) =&gt; r.referrerUserId);\n  const topReferrerUsers = await prisma.user.findMany({\n    where: { id: { in: topReferrerIds } },\n    select: { id: true, name: true, email: true },\n  });\n\n  const conversionRate = totalReferrals &gt; 0\n    ? ((redeemedReferrals / totalReferrals) * 100).toFixed(1)\n    : '0.0';\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"p-4 sm:p-6\"&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { requireMerchantRole } from '@/lib/rbac';\nimport { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';\nimport { formatCurrency } from '@/lib/utils';\n\nexport default async function AnalyticsPage({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {\n  const session = await auth();\n  if (!session?.user?.id) {\n    redirect('/login');\n  }\n\n  const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n    where: { slug: params.slug },\n  });\n\n  if (!merchant) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_staff');\n\n  // Get analytics data\n  const [\n    totalRedemptions,\n    totalRevenue,\n    totalCreditsIssued,\n    topVouchers,\n    recentRedemptions,\n  ] = await Promise.all([\n    prisma.redemption.count({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        confirmedAt: { not: null },\n      },\n    }),\n    prisma.redemption.aggregate({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        confirmedAt: { not: null },\n      },\n      _sum: {\n        discountApplied: true,\n      },\n    }),\n    prisma.creditLedger.aggregate({\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id },\n      _sum: { amount: true },\n    }),\n    prisma.voucher.findMany({\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id },\n      include: {\n        _count: {\n          select: {\n            redemptions: {\n              where: { confirmedAt: { not: null } },\n            },\n          },\n        },\n      },\n      orderBy: {\n        redemptions: {\n          _count: 'desc',\n        },\n      },\n      take: 5,\n    }),\n    prisma.redemption.findMany({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        confirmedAt: { not: null },\n      },\n      include: {\n        voucher: {\n          select: { id: true, type: true },\n        },\n      },\n      orderBy: { confirmedAt: 'desc' },\n      take: 10,\n    }),\n  ]);\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"p-4 sm:p-6\"&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "# Täiustuste kokkuvõte\n\n## ✅ Valmis täiustused\n\n### 1. Toast Notifications System\n- ✅ Radix UI toast komponendid\n- ✅ Success, error, info variandid\n- ✅ Auto-dismiss funktsioon\n- ✅ Helper funktsioonid (&#96;showSuccess&#96;, &#96;showError&#96;, &#96;showInfo&#96;)\n- ✅ Integreeritud root layout'is\n\n### 2. Loading States\n- ✅ &#96;LoadingButton&#96; komponent spinner'iga\n- ✅ &#96;Skeleton&#96; komponent loading state'ide jaoks\n- ✅ Näide kasutamisest &#96;publish-button.tsx&#96;'is\n\n### 3. Analytics Dashboard\n- ✅ Uus analytics leht (&#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96;)\n- ✅ Total redemptions, revenue, credits issued\n- ✅ Top vouchers statistika\n- ✅ Recent redemptions list\n- ✅ Link dashboard'ist\n\n### 4. UI Komponendid\n- ✅ &#96;Select&#96; komponent (Radix UI)\n- ✅ &#96;Skeleton&#96; loading komponent\n- ✅ &#96;LoadingButton&#96; komponent\n- ✅ &#96;Toast&#96; süsteem\n\n## 📋 Järgmised sammud (valikuline)\n\n### Prioriteet 1\n1. **Asendada kõik alert() kutsed toast'idega**\n   - &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new/page.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/redemptions/confirm-button.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/r/[id]/referral-client.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo/page.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/v/[id]/voucher-client.tsx&#96;\n\n2. **Voucher otsing ja filtreerimine**\n   - Otsing välja\n   - Filtreerimine staatuse, tüübi, kuupäeva järgi\n   - Sortimine\n\n3. **Parem error handling UI**\n   - Error boundaries\n   - Retry mechanisms\n\n### Prioriteet 2\n4. **Email notifications**\n   - Credit unlock notifications\n   - Redemption confirmations\n   - Weekly drop reminders\n\n5. **Voucher mallid**\n   - Eeldefineeritud mallid\n   - Mallide salvestamine\n   - Kiire loomine\n\n6. **Export funktsioonid**\n   - CSV export redemptions\n   - Credits ledger export\n\n### Prioriteet 3\n7. **Graafikud ja visualisatsioonid**\n   - Chart.js või Recharts integratsioon\n   - Time-series graafikud\n   - Conversion funnels\n\n8. **Bulk operations**\n   - Mitme voucher'i korraga avaldamine\n   - CSV import\n\n## 🚀 Kuidas kasutada",

'@/lib/rbac';\nimport { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';\nimport Link from 'next/link';\nimport { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';\n\nexport default async function MerchantDashboardPage({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {\n  const session = await auth();\n  if (!session?.user?.id) redirect('/login');\n\n  const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({ where: { slug: params.slug } });\n  if (!merchant) notFound();\n\n  await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_staff');\n\n  const now = new Date();\n  const dayStart = startOfDay(now);\n  const weekStart = startOfWeek(now, { weekStartsOn: 1 });\n\n  const [\n    activeVouchers,\n    activeCampaigns,\n    activeEvents,\n    redemptionsToday,\n    redemptionsThisWeek,\n    redemptionCount,\n    pendingRedemptions,\n    totalCreditsIssued,\n    totalRevenue,\n    outstandingLiability,\n    ticketRevenue,\n    ticketsSold,\n  ] = await Promise.all([\n    prisma.voucher.count({ where: { merchantId: merchant.id, status: 'published' } }),\n    prisma.campaign.count({ where: { merchantId: merchant.id, status: 'active' } }),\n    prisma.event.count({ where: { merchantId: merchant.id, status: 'published' } }),\n    prisma.redemption.count({\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id, createdAt: { gte: dayStart } },\n    }),\n    prisma.redemption.count({\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id, createdAt: { gte: weekStart } },\n    }),\n    prisma.redemption.count({\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id, confirmedAt: { not: null } },\n    }),\n    prisma.redemption.count({\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id, confirmedAt: null },\n    }),\n    prisma.creditLedger.aggregate({\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id },\n      _sum: { amount: true },\n    }),\n    // Revenue: sum of paid voucher purchases\n    prisma.voucherPurchase.aggregate\n\n;\n}",

        "contents": "export default async function MerchantDashboardPage({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {\nconst [\n    activeVouchers,\n    activeCampaigns,\n    activeEvents,\n    redemptionsToday,\n    redemptionsThisWeek,\n    redemptionCount,\n    pendingRedemptions,\n    totalCreditsIssued,\n    totalRevenue,\n    outstandingLiability,\n    ticketRevenue,\n    ticketsSold,\n  ] = await \n({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        status: { in: ['sold', 'used'] },\n      },\n    }),\n  ]);\n\n  const creditsFormatted =\n    totalCreditsIssued._sum.amount != null\n      ? (totalCreditsIssued._sum.amount / 100).toFixed(2)\n      : '0.00';\n\n  const revenueFormatted =\n    totalRevenue._sum.amount != null\n      ? (totalRevenue._sum.amount / 100).toFixed(2)\n      : '0.00';\n\n  // Calculate outstanding liability from voucher values\n  const liabilityAmount = outstandingLiability.reduce((sum, purchase) =&gt; {\n    return sum + (purchase.voucher?.value || 0);\n  }, 0);\n  const liabilityFormatted = (liabilityAmount / 100).toFixed(2);\n\n  const ticketRevenueFormatted =\n    ticketRevenue._sum.amount != null\n      ? (ticketRevenue._sum.amount / 100).toFixed(2)\n      : '0.00';\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"p-4 sm:p-6\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"max-w-6xl mx-auto\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:justify-between sm:items-center gap-4 mb-8\"&gt;\n          &lt;div&gt;\n            &lt;h1 className=\"text-2xl font-semibold text-foreground\"&gt;Dashboard&lt;/h1&gt;\n            &lt;p className=\"text-sm text-muted-foreground\"&gt;{merchant.name}&lt;/p&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "# Täiustuste plaan\n\n## Prioriteet 1: UX täiustused\n\n### 1. Kõik todo-d on tehtud. Kokkuvõte:

## Lõpetatud ülesanded

### 1. Voucher redigeerimine
- Loodud `edit-voucher-form.tsx` komponent
- Vorm toetab kõiki voucher väljasid (type, value, design, weekly drop, jne)
- API endpoint (`PUT /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]`) on olemas ja töötab

### 2. Liikmete kutsumine
- Loodud `invite-member-form.tsx` komponent
- API endpoint (`POST /api/merchant/[slug]/members`)
- Email kutsed (`sendMemberInviteEmail`)
- RBAC kontrollid (ainult merchant_admin saab kutsuda)

### 3. Platform admin UI
- Täiendatud `/admin` leht
- Merchant'ide haldus (activate/deactivate)
- Feature flag'ide haldus
- Audit log vaatamine
- API endpoint'id: `/api/admin/merchants`, `/api/admin/merchants/[id]`, `/api/admin/audit-log`

### 4. Security headers
- Lisatud CSP (Content Security Policy) `next.config.js`'i
- Kõik vajalikud security header'id on konfigureeritud

### 5. Voucher otsing ja filtreerimine
- Loodud `vouchers-list-client.tsx` komponent
- Otsing (headline, code prefix, ID)
- Filtreerimine (status, type)
- Sortimine (date, name, redemptions)

### 6. QR code allalaadimine
- Komponent `components/qr-download.tsx` on juba olemas ja töötab

### 7. Referral analytics
- Leht `/merchant/[slug]/referrals` on juba olemas
- Näitab: total referrals, opened, redeemed, conversion rate, top referrers

### 8. E2E testid
- Täiendatud `e2e/voucher-flow.spec.ts`
- Lisatud testid: voucher flow, public pages, referral pages, merchant dashboard, redemptions
- Parandatud selector'id ja flow'd

### 9. Production setup
- Loodud `docs/PRODUCTION_SETUP.md`
- Juhend environment variables'ide, database, Redis, Sentry, Stripe, email, cron job'ide seadistamiseks

### 10. Database migrations
- Dokumentatsioon `docs/MIGRATIONS.md` on juba olemas
- Juhend migration'ite loomiseks ja kasutamiseks

Kõik kõrge prioriteediga ülesanded on lõpetatud. Projekt on valmis production'iks, kui on tehtud production setup (environment variables, database migrations, jne).

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { checkRedemptionRateLimit, isSelfReferral, checkIPRateLimit } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { requireActiveMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createRedemptionSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  referralId: z.string().optional(),\n  method: z.enum(['online', 'in_store']),\n  orderReference: z.string().optional(),\n  amountBeforeDiscount: z.number().int().positive(),\n  discountApplied: z.number().int().nonnegative(),\n  currency: z.string(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    // IP-based rate limiting for public redemptions\n    const ip = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0] || \n               req.headers.get('x-real-ip') || \n               'unknown';\n    const ipRateLimit = checkIPRateLimit(ip, 60, 50); // 50 per hour per IP\n    if (!ipRateLimit.allowed) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: ipRateLimit.remaining },\n        { status: 429 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    const session = await auth();\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const data = createRedemptionSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: data.voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    // Check merchant is active (kill switch)\n    try {\n      await requireActiveMerchant(voucher.merchantId);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      if (error.message?.includes('inactive')) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant is inactive' }, { status: 403 });\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published')\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { applyCredit } from '@/lib/credits';\nimport { getMerchantBySlug } from '@/lib/tenant';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst applyCreditSchema = z.object({\n  merchantSlug: z.string(),\n  amount: z.number().int().positive(),\n  orderReference: z.string().optional(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const { merchantSlug, amount, orderReference } = applyCreditSchema.parse(body);\n\n    const merchant = await getMerchantBySlug(merchantSlug);\n    if (!merchant) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    const result = await applyCredit(session.user.id, merchant.id, amount, orderReference || '');\n\n    return NextResponse.json(result);\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    if (error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.message === 'Insufficient credit balance') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    console.error('Error applying credit:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\app\\api\\referrals\\create\\route.ts",

            "column": 1

        },
        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { hashFriendIdentifier } from '@/lib/utils';\nimport { checkReferralRateLimit } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createReferralSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  friendHint: z.string().optional(), // optional identifier hint for friend\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const { voucherId, friendHint } = createReferralSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not available' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check rate limit\n    const rateLimit = await checkReferralRateLimit(session.user.id);\n    if (!rateLimit.allowed) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: rateLimit.remaining },\n        { status: 429 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Hash friend identifier if provided\n    const friendHash = friendHint\n      ? await hashFriendIdentifier(friendHint)\n      : &#96;anonymous_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}&#96;;\n\n    // Create referral\n    const referral = await prisma.referral.create({\n      data: {\n        voucherId: voucher.id,\n        merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n        referrerUserId: session.user.id,\n        friendHash,\n        status: 'created',\n      },\n    });\n\n    // Generate share URL\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${referral.id}&#96;;\n\n    return NextResponse.json\n\n}",

        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n\n\n    if (!weeklyDrop) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Weekly drop configuration missing' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check if we're in the drop window\n    const now = new Date();\n    const dayOfWeek = now.getDay();\n    const [hours, minutes] = weeklyDrop.startTime.split(':').map(Number);\n    const startTime = new Date(now);\n    startTime.setHours(hours, minutes, 0, 0);\n    const endTime = new Date(startTime);\n    endTime.setMinutes(endTime.getMinutes() + weeklyDrop.durationMinutes);\n\n    if (dayOfWeek !== weeklyDrop.dayOfWeek || now &lt; startTime || now &gt; endTime) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Weekly drop not active' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Atomically check stock and create referral\n    const result = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) =&gt; {\n      // Count existing referrals for this voucher created in this drop window\n      const existingCount = await tx.referral.count({\n        where: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          createdAt: {\n            gte: startTime,\n            lte: endTime,\n          },\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (existingCount &gt;= weeklyDrop.stock) {\n        throw new Error('Weekly drop sold out');\n      }\n\n      // Create referral\n      const friendHash = friendHint\n        ? await hashFriendIdentifier(friendHint)\n        : &#96;anonymous_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}&#96;;\n\n      const referral = await tx.referral.create({\n        data: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n          referrerUserId: session.user.id,\n          friendHash,\n          status: 'created',\n        },\n      });\n\n      return referral;\n    });\n\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${result.id}&#96;;\n\n    return NextResponse.json({\n      referralId: result.id,\n      shareUrl,\n      remaining: weeklyDrop.stock - 1, // Approximate\n    });\n  } catch (error)\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { hashFriendIdentifier } from '@/lib/utils';\nimport { isFeatureEnabled } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst claimSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  friendHint: z.string().optional(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const { voucherId, friendHint } = claimSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher with weekly drop info\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    // Check feature flag\n    const weeklyDropsEnabled = await isFeatureEnabled(voucher.merchantId, 'weeklyDropsEnabled');\n    if (!weeklyDropsEnabled) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Weekly drops are not enabled for this merchant' }, { status: 403 });\n    }\n\n    if (!voucher.weeklyDropEnabled) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Weekly drop not enabled for this voucher' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not available' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    const weeklyDrop = voucher.weeklyDropJson\n      ? (JSON.parse(voucher.weeklyDropJson as string) as {\n          dayOfWeek: number;\n          startTime: string;\n          stock: number;\n          durationMinutes: number;\n        })\n      : null;\n\n    if (!weeklyDrop) {\n      return NextResponse.json\n}",

        "contents": "export async function PUT(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { slug: string; id: string } }\n) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n      where: { slug: params.slug },\n    });\n\n    if (!merchant) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id,         "contents": "export async function PUT(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { slug: string; id: string } }\n) {\n\n    if (data.usageLimitTotal !== undefined) updateData.usageLimitTotal = data.usageLimitTotal;\n    if (data.usageLimitPerUser !== undefined) updateData.usageLimitPerUser = data.usageLimitPerUser;\n    if (data.weeklyDropEnabled !== undefined) updateData.weeklyDropEnabled = data.weeklyDropEnabled;\n    if (data.weeklyDropJson !== undefined) {\n      updateData.weeklyDropJson = data.weeklyDropJson ? JSON.stringify(data.weeklyDropJson) : Prisma.DbNull;\n    }\n    if (data.conditionsJson !== undefined) {\n      updateData.conditionsJson = data.conditionsJson ? JSON.stringify(data.conditionsJson) : Prisma.DbNull;\n    }\n    if (data.designJson !== undefined) {\n      updateData.designJson = data.designJson ? JSON.stringify(data.designJson) : Prisma.DbNull;\n    }\n    if (data.codePrefix !== undefined) updateData.codePrefix = data.codePrefix;\n\n    const updated = await prisma.voucher.update({\n      where: { id: params.id },\n      data: updateData,\n    });\n\n    // Log audit\n    await prisma.auditLog.create({\n      data: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        actorUserId: session.user.id,\n        action: 'voucher.updated',\n        payloadJson: JSON.stringify({ voucherId: params.id, changes: Object.keys(updateData) }),\n      },\n    });\n\n    return NextResponse.json(updated);\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    console.error('Error updating voucher:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}\n\nexport async function GET(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { slug: string; id: string } }\n) {\n  \n}",
