        "contents": "export async function GET(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { slug: string; id: string } }\n) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n      where: { slug: params.slug },\n    });\n\n    if (!merchant) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: params.id },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher || voucher.merchantId !== merchant.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    // Check permissions\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published') {\n      if (!session?.user?.id) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n      }\n      try {\n        await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_staff');\n      } catch {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden' }, { status: 403 });\n      }\n    }\n\n    return NextResponse.json(voucher);\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error fetching voucher:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export async function POST(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { slug: string } }\n) {\n\n  }\n}\n\nexport async function GET(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { slug: string } }\n) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n      where: { slug: params.slug },\n    });\n\n    if (!merchant) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    // If authenticated and has merchant role, show all vouchers\n    // Otherwise, show only published vouchers\n    const where: {\n      merchantId: string;\n      status?: string;\n    } = { merchantId: merchant.id };\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      where.status = 'published';\n    } else {\n      try {\n        await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_staff');\n      } catch {\n        where.status = 'published';\n      }\n    }\n\n    const vouchers = await prisma.voucher.findMany({\n      where,\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    });\n\n    return NextResponse.json(vouchers);\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error fetching vouchers:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { requireMerchantRole } from '@/lib/rbac';\nimport { requireActiveMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\nimport { ensureMerchantOwnership } from '@/lib/tenant';\n\nexport async function POST(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { id: string } }\n) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: params.id },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    await requireActiveMerchant(voucher.merchantId);\n    await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, voucher.merchantId, 'merchant_admin');\n\n    // Validate voucher can be published\n    if (voucher.status === 'published') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher already published' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    if (!voucher.designJson) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher design is required' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Update status to published\n    const updated = await prisma.voucher.update({\n      where: { id: params.id },\n      data: { status: 'published' },\n    });\n\n    // Log audit\n    await prisma.auditLog.create({\n      data: {\n        merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n        actorUserId: session.user.id,\n        action: 'voucher.published',\n        payloadJson: JSON.stringify({ voucherId: params.id }),\n      },\n    });\n\n    return NextResponse.json(updated);\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error publishing voucher:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\nconst ;\n        if (!rateLimit.allowed) {\n          return NextResponse.json(\n            { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: rateLimit.remaining },\n            { status: 429 }\n          );\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Create redemption (unconfirmed initially)\n    const redemption = await prisma.redemption.create({\n      data: {\n        voucherId: voucher.id,\n        merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n        referralId: data.referralId,\n        redeemedByUserId: session?.user?.id || null,\n        method: data.method,\n        orderReference: data.orderReference,\n        amountBeforeDiscount: data.amountBeforeDiscount,\n        discountApplied: data.discountApplied,\n        currency: data.currency,\n        confirmedAt: null,\n      },\n    });\n\n    // If there's a referral, create locked credit\n    if (data.referralId) {\n      const referral = await prisma.referral.findUnique({\n        where: { id: data.referralId },\n        include: { referrer: true },\n      });\n\n      if (referral) {\n        // Calculate credit amount (for MVP, use a fixed percentage or voucher value)\n        let creditAmount = 0;\n        if (voucher.type === 'credit_amount') {\n          creditAmount = voucher.value;\n        } else if (voucher.type === 'fixed_amount') {\n          creditAmount = voucher.value; // Same as discount\n        } else {\n          // Percentage: give 10% of discount as credit (configurable)\n          creditAmount = Math.floor(data.discountApplied * 0.1);\n        }\n\n        if (creditAmount &gt; 0) {\n          const expiresAt = new Date();\n          expiresAt.setDate(expiresAt.getDate() + 60); // Default 60 days\n\n          await prisma.creditLedger.create({\n            data: {\n              merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n              userId: referral.referrerUserId,\n              amount: creditAmount,\n              currency: voucher.currency,\n              status: 'locked',\n              source: 'referral_redemption',\n              sourceId: redemption.id,\n              expiresAt,\n            },\n          });\n\n          // Update referral status\n          await\n}",

        "contents": "# Täiustuste plaan\n\n## Prioriteet 1: UX täiustused\n\n### 1.         "contents": "# Rahvusvaheliseks tegemise staatus\n\n## ✅ Valmis\n\n1. **i18n konfiguratsioon**\n   - ✅ 5 keelt: en, et, es, fr, de\n   - ✅ Routing konfiguratsioon\n   - ✅ Middleware locale detection'iga\n\n2. **Tõlked**\n   - ✅ Inglise (en) - täielik\n   - ✅ Eesti (et) - täielik\n   - ✅ Hispaania (es) - täielik\n   - ✅ Prantsuse (fr) - täielik\n   - ✅ Saksa (de) - täielik\n\n3. **Komponendid**\n   - ✅ Language selector\n   - ✅ Locale-aware layout\n   - ✅ i18n utilities (valuuta, kuupäevad)\n\n4. **Dokumentatsioon**\n   - ✅ I18N_GUIDE.md - täielik juhend\n\n## ⚠️ Vajab täiendamist\n\n### 1. Olemasolevate lehtede migreerimine\n\nPraegu on palju lehti, mis ei kasuta tõlkeid. Need tuleb järk-järgult migreerida:\n\n**Prioriteet 1 (kõrge):**\n- &#96;app/login/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/app/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/v/[id]/voucher-client.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/r/[id]/referral-client.tsx&#96;\n\n**Prioriteet 2 (keskmine):**\n- &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/dashboard/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet/page.tsx&#96;\n\n**Prioriteet 3 (madal):**\n- Kõik ülejäänud lehed\n\n### 2. Kuidas migreerida lehte\n\n1. **Lisa &#96;useTranslations&#96; hook**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';\n   \n   const t = useTranslations('voucher');\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Asenda hardcoded stringid**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   // Enne:\n   &lt;h1&gt;Vouchers&lt;/h1&gt;\n   \n   // Pärast:\n   &lt;h1&gt;{t('vouchers')}&lt;/h1&gt;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Kasuta &#96;Link&#96; komponenti &#96;@/routing&#96;'ist**:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   import { Link } from '@/routing';\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. URL struktuur\n\nPraegu:\n- &#96;/v/[id]&#96; - töötab (inglise keel)\n- &#96;/et/v/[id]&#96; - töötab (eesti keel)\n- &#96;/es/v/[id]&#96; - töötab (hispaania keel)\n\nKõik lehed peaksid toetama locale prefix'it.\n\n## 📝 Järgmised sammud\n\n1. **Migreeri kõige kasutatavamad lehed** (login, voucher, referral)\n2. **Testi kõik keeled**\n3. **Lisa puuduvad tõlked** (kui vaja)\n4. **Paranda URL struktuuri** (kui vaja)\n\n## 🎯 Eesmärk",

        "contents": "- Mitme voucher'i korraga avaldamine\n   - CSV import\n\n## 🚀 Kuidas kasutada\n\n### Toast notifications\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { showSuccess, showError, showInfo } from '@/lib/toast-helpers';\n\nshowSuccess('Operation completed!');\nshowError('Something went wrong');\nshowInfo('Processing...');\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Loading Button\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { LoadingButton } from '@/components/ui/loading-button';\n\n&lt;LoadingButton \n  loading={isLoading} \n  loadingText=\"Saving...\"\n  onClick={handleSave}\n&gt;\n  Save\n&lt;/LoadingButton&gt;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Analytics\nNavigeeri &#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96; et näha statistikaid.\n\n## 📦 Uued sõltuvused\n\n- &#96;lucide-react&#96; - ikoonid (toast, loading spinner)\n\n## 📝 Märkused\n\n- Toast süsteem on valmis ja töökorras\n- Analytics dashboard näitab põhistatistikat\n- Loading states on implementeeritud\n- Kõik komponendid on TypeScript tüüpidega",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp; vouchers\n\n### MVP UI Scope\n**PUBLIC:**\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page\n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n**USER:**\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo\n\n**MERCHANT:**\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n**Non-MVP (Documented):**\n- &#96;/admin&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;         "contents": "export function generateStaticParams() {\n  return routing.locales.map((locale) =&gt; ({ locale }));\n}\n\nexport default async function LocaleLayout({\n  children,\n  params,\n}: {\n  children: React.ReactNode;\n  params: { locale: string } | Promise&lt;{ locale: string }&gt;;\n}) {\n  const p = await Promise.resolve(params);\n  const locale = p?.locale;\n  if (!locale || !routing.locales.includes(locale as (typeof routing.locales)[number])) {\n    redirect(&#96;/${routing.defaultLocale}&#96;);\n  }\n  setRequestLocale(locale);\n\n  let messages;\n  try {\n    messages = await getMessages();\n  } catch (err) {\n    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {\n      // eslint-disable-next-line no-console\n      console.error('[LocaleLayout] getMessages failed:', err);\n    }\n    throw err;\n  }\n\n  const t = await getTranslations('nav');\n}",

        "contents": "# Täiustuste plaan\n\n## Prioriteet 1: UX täiustused\n\n### 1. Toast Notifications\n- ✅ Asendada kõik &#96;alert()&#96; kutsed toast notification'itega\n- ✅ Success, error, info toast'id\n- ✅ Auto-dismiss funktsioon\n\n### 2. Loading States\n- ✅ Button loading states\n- ✅ Page loading skeletons\n- ✅ Form submission indicators\n\n### 3. Analytics &amp; Statistika\n- ✅ Dashboard graafikud (Chart.js või Recharts)\n- ✅ Voucher performance metrics\n- ✅ Referral conversion rates\n- ✅ Credit usage analytics\n\n### 4. Parem Error Handling UI\n- ✅ Error boundaries\n- ✅ User-friendly error messages\n- ✅ Retry mechanisms\n\n## Prioriteet 2: Funktsionaalsed täiustused\n\n### 5. Voucher Otsing &amp; Filtreerimine\n- ✅ Otsing voucher'ite hulgas\n- ✅ Filtreerimine staatuse, tüübi, kuupäeva järgi\n- ✅ Sortimine\n\n### 6. Voucher Mallid\n- ✅ Eeldefineeritud mallid\n- ✅ Mallide salvestamine\n- ✅ Kiire voucher'ite loomine mallidest\n\n### 7. Bulk Operations\n- ✅ Mitme voucher'i korraga avaldamine/pausimine\n- ✅ CSV export/import\n- ✅ Bulk redemptions\n\n### 8. Email Notifications\n- ✅ Credit unlock notifications\n- ✅ Redemption confirmations\n- ✅ Weekly drop reminders\n- ✅ Credit expiry warnings\n\n## Prioriteet 3: Täiendavad funktsioonid\n\n### 9. Parem Navigation\n- ✅ Mobile-friendly navigation\n- ✅ Breadcrumbs\n- ✅ Quick actions menu\n\n### 10. Export Funktsioonid\n- ✅ Redemptions CSV export\n- ✅ Credits ledger export\n- ✅ Analytics reports PDF\n\n### 11. Voucher Kategooriad\n- ✅ Kategooriate süsteem\n- ✅ Filtreerimine kategooria järgi\n- ✅ Kategooriate haldus\n\n### 12. Advanced Analytics\n- ✅ Referral tracking (UTM parameters)\n- ✅ Conversion funnels\n- ✅ Cohort analysis\n- ✅ Revenue attribution\n\n## Prioriteet 4: Tehnilised täiustused\n\n### 13. Caching Strategy\n- ✅ Redis caching public voucher pages\n- ✅ API response caching\n- ✅ Optimistic updates\n\n### 14. Performance\n- ✅ Image optimization\n- ✅ Code splitting\n- ✅ Lazy loading\n\n### 15. Testing",

        "contents": "# Changelog\n\n## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-XX\n\n### Added\n- Multi-tenant voucher platform with merchant isolation\n- Voucher creation, publishing, and management\n- Referral system with shareable links\n- Credit system (locked/unlocked states)\n- Weekly drop functionality with stock management\n- PWA support with service worker and offline QR codes\n- RBAC (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- Fraud prevention (rate limiting, self-referral prevention)\n- Email magic link authentication\n- Google and Apple OAuth support\n- Merchant dashboard\n- User wallet and credit management\n- Checkout demo for credit application\n- API documentation\n- Unit tests for credit system\n- Seed data script\n- Docker compose setup for local development\n\n### Technical\n- Next.js 14 with App Router\n- TypeScript strict mode\n- Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL\n- TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui components\n- NextAuth for authentication\n- Zod for validation\n- Vitest for testing\n- i18n structure (next-intl, ready for expansion)\n\n## [1.1.0] - 2024-01-XX (Planned)\n\n### Added\n- Voucher publish endpoint\n- Voucher update endpoint\n- Better error handling with custom error classes\n- Type definitions\n- Session provider for client components\n- Validation utilities\n\n### Fixed\n- Missing publish functionality\n- TypeScript type safety improvements",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp; vouchers\n\n### MVP UI Scope\n**PUBLIC:**\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page\n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n**USER:**\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo\n\n**MERCHANT:**\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n**Non-MVP (Documented):**\n- &#96;/admin&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; - Public merchant page (should be removed per spec)\n\n### UI Look &amp; Feel\n- ✅ Premium, calm, confident design\n- ✅ Mobile-first responsive\n- ✅ One primary CTA per screen\n- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s",

        "contents": "---\nname: voucher\ndescription: This is a new rule\n---\n\n# Voucher Rules\n\n## 0) SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH\n\nAinus tõde on TOTAL / ALL-IN PROMPT + MVP UI Scope-lock + Business Rules.\n\nKui miski on vastuolus → ära ehita.\n\nKüsimuse korral → küsi enne.\n\n## 1) MVP SCOPE ON LUKUS\n\nEHITADA TOHIB AINULT:\n\nVoucher → Referral → Redemption → Credit → Wallet\n\nPublic pages ilma login’ita\n\nMerchant dashboard minimaalses mahus\n\nKEELATUD MVP-S:\n\nmarketplace\n\nfeed\n\nkommentaarid / like’id\n\nloyalty tiers / badges\n\nads\n\nAI\n\ngrowth-hackid\n\nextra analytics\n\nKui funktsioon ei aita jagada, lunastada või krediteerida, siis ära ehita.\n\n## 2) TECH STACK ON LUKUS\n\nNext.js (App Router)\n\nTypeScript kõikjal\n\nPrisma + PostgreSQL\n\nshadcn/ui + Tailwind\n\nPWA (manifest + service worker)\n\nnext-intl (EN default)\n\nEi mingeid:\n\nteisi frameworke\n\ncustom CSS süsteeme\n\nteisi ORM-e\n\nparoolipõhist auth’i\n\n## 3) ROLLID &amp; ÕIGUSED (RANGE)\n\nanonymous → ainult public pages\n\nuser → ainult enda wallet &amp; vouchers\n\nmerchant_staff → redemption confirm\n\nmerchant_admin → voucherid, settings\n\nplatform_admin → audit &amp; risk\n\nReegel:\nUI võib peita, server peab alati kontrollima.\n\n## 4) PUBLIC PAGES REEGEL (KRIITILINE)\n\n/v/[voucherId] ja /r/[referralId]:\n\nEI TOHI nõuda login’it\n\nPEAVAD avanema &lt;1s\n\nPEAVAD töötama mobiilis ideaalselt\n\nJagamine peab olema 1 tap.\n\n## 5) BUSINESS RULES (MITTEVAIDLUSTATAV)\n\nCredit ≠ raha\n\nCredit on merchant-põhine\n\nCredit:\n\nalgul locked\n\navailable ainult pärast redemption confirm\n\naegub\n\nSelf-referral on keelatud\n\nWeekly Drop:\n\nlimited stock\n\nfirst-come-first-served\n\nkui otsas → otsas\n\n## 6) DATA &amp; TRANSACTIONS\n\nKõik write’id:\n\ntransaction’iga\n\nserver-side validatsioon\n\nÄra salvesta:\n\nraw phone/email (hash ainult)\n\nPrisma schema = püha\n\nÄra kasuta JSON-i, kui on vaja relatsiooni (v.a designJson, conditionsJson).\n\n## 7) UI &amp; UX REEGLID\n\n1 primary CTA per vaade\n\nMobile-first (desktop = enhancement)\n\nEi mingeid “wizard’eid” üle 2 sammu\n\nEi mingeid modal-hell’e\n\nCredit peab tunduma päris väärtusena",

        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\app\\api\\redemptions\\route.ts",
        "range": {

            "line": 177,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { checkRedemptionRateLimit, isSelfReferral, checkIPRateLimit } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { requireActiveMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createRedemptionSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  referralId: z.string().optional(),\n  method: z.enum(['online', 'in_store']),\n  orderReference: z.string().optional(),\n  amountBeforeDiscount: z.number().int().positive(),\n  discountApplied: z.number().int().nonnegative(),\n  currency: z.string(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    // IP-based rate limiting for public redemptions\n    const ip = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0] || \n               req.headers.get('x-real-ip') || \n               'unknown';\n    const ipRateLimit = checkIPRateLimit(ip, 60, 50); // 50 per hour per IP\n    if (!ipRateLimit.allowed) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: ipRateLimit.remaining },\n        { status: 429 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    const session = await auth();\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const data = createRedemptionSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: data.voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    // Check merchant is active (kill switch)\n    try {\n      await requireActiveMerchant(voucher.merchantId);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      if (error.message?.includes('inactive')) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant is inactive' }, { status: 403 });\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published')\n}",

        "contents": "# Rahvusvaheliseks tegemise staatus\n\n## ✅ Valmis\n\n1. **i18n konfiguratsioon**\n   - ✅ 5 keelt: en, et, es, fr, de\n   - ✅ Routing konfiguratsioon\n   - ✅ Middleware locale detection'iga\n\n2. **Tõlked**\n   - ✅ Inglise (en) - täielik\n   - ✅ Eesti (et) - täielik\n   - ✅ Hispaania (es) - täielik\n   - ✅ Prantsuse (fr) - täielik\n   - ✅ Saksa (de) - täielik\n\n3. **Komponendid**\n   - ✅ Language selector\n   - ✅ Locale-aware layout\n   - ✅ i18n utilities (valuuta, kuupäevad)\n\n4. **Dokumentatsioon**\n   - ✅ I18N_GUIDE.md - täielik juhend\n\n## ⚠️ Vajab täiendamist\n\n### 1. Olemasolevate lehtede migreerimine\n\nPraegu on palju lehti, mis ei kasuta tõlkeid. Need tuleb järk-järgult migreerida:\n\n**Prioriteet 1 (kõrge):**\n- &#96;app/login/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/app/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/v/[id]/voucher-client.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/r/[id]/referral-client.tsx&#96;\n\n**Prioriteet 2 (keskmine):**\n- &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/dashboard/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new/page.tsx&#96;\n- &#96;app/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet/page.tsx&#96;\n\n**Prioriteet 3 (madal):**\n- Kõik ülejäänud lehed\n\n### 2.         "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { checkRedemptionRateLimit, isSelfReferral, checkIPRateLimit } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { requireActiveMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createRedemptionSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  referralId: z.string().optional(),\n  method: z.enum(['online', 'in_store']),\n  orderReference: z.string().optional(),\n  amountBeforeDiscount: z.number().int().positive(),\n  discountApplied: z.number().int().nonnegative(),\n  currency: z.string(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    // IP-based rate limiting for public redemptions\n    const ip = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0] || \n               req.headers.get('x-real-ip') || \n               'unknown';\n    const ipRateLimit = checkIPRateLimit(ip, 60, 50); // 50 per hour per IP\n    if (!ipRateLimit.allowed) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: ipRateLimit.remaining },\n        { status: 429 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    const session = await auth();\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const data = createRedemptionSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: data.voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    // Check merchant is active (kill switch)\n    try {\n      await requireActiveMerchant(voucher.merchantId);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      if (error.message?.includes('inactive')) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant is inactive' }, { status: 403 });\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published')\n}",

      "codeBlock": {

        "range": {

        "contents": "- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s\n- ✅ Share in 1 tap\n- ✅ No signup wall on public pages\n- ✅ Available credit BIG in wallet\n- ✅ Locked credit clearly separated\n- ✅ Expiry visible\n\n### Data Model\nAll required models present:\n- ✅ Merchant\n- ✅ MerchantMember\n- ✅ User\n- ✅ Voucher\n- ✅ Referral\n- ✅ Redemption\n- ✅ CreditLedger\n- ✅ CreditUsage\n- ✅ AuditLog\n\nBusiness rules:\n- ✅ Credit ≠ money\n- ✅ Credit per-merchant\n- ✅ Credit expires (60 days default)\n- ✅ Credit starts LOCKED\n- ✅ Unlock only after redemption confirmation\n- ✅ No self-referral\n- ✅ Weekly drops have fixed stock\n\n### Core Flows (All Working)\n- ✅ **A)** Merchant creates voucher → publish\n- ✅ **B)** User shares voucher\n- ✅ **C)** Friend redeems voucher\n- ✅ **D)** Staff confirms redemption\n- ✅ **E)** Credit unlocks\n- ✅ **F)** User applies credit in checkout demo\n\n### Weekly Drops\n- ✅ Optional per voucher\n- ✅ Time window + stock\n- ✅ First come, first served\n- ✅ No notifications in MVP\n\n### Security &amp; Fraud\n- ✅ Rate limits\n- ✅ Device/IP heuristics\n- ✅ Hashed friend identifiers\n- ✅ Audit admin/staff actions\n\n### PWA Requirements\n- ✅ Installable (manifest.json)\n- ✅ Native mobile share\n- ✅ Offline QR for opened vouchers\n- ✅ Works on iOS &amp; Android browsers\n\n### Forbidden Features\n- ✅ No marketplace\n- ✅ No public feeds (except &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; which should be removed)\n- ✅ No comments\n- ✅ No likes\n- ✅ No loyalty tiers\n- ✅ No AI\n- ✅ No ads\n- ✅ No influencer dashboards\n\n## ⚠️ Action Items\n\n### High Priority\n1. **Remove &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; page** - Not in MVP scope per spec\n2. **Hide non-MVP links** - ✅ Done (removed from dashboard)\n\n### Medium Priority\n3. **Verify all 8 done definition steps work locally**\n4. **Test PWA on iOS/Android**\n\n### Low Priority\n5. **Add feature flags to Merchant model** (for launch mode)\n6. **Implement kill switch** (for launch mode)",

        "contents": "const createVoucherSchema = \n\n  designJson: z.any().optional(),\n  codePrefix: z.string().optional(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { slug: string } }\n) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n      where: { slug: params.slug },\n    });\n\n    if (!merchant) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    await requireActiveMerchant(merchant.id);\n    await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_admin');\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const data = createVoucherSchema.parse(body);\n\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.create({\n      data: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        status: 'draft',\n        ...data,\n        validFrom: new Date(data.validFrom),\n        validTo: new Date(data.validTo),\n        weeklyDropJson: data.weeklyDropJson ? JSON.stringify(data.weeklyDropJson) : Prisma.DbNull,\n        conditionsJson: data.conditionsJson ? JSON.stringify(data.conditionsJson) : Prisma.DbNull,\n        designJson: data.designJson ? JSON.stringify(data.designJson) : Prisma.DbNull,\n      },\n    });\n\n    return NextResponse.json(voucher);\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    console.error('Error creating voucher:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Handle errors and return appropriate HTTP response\n */\nexport function handleError(error: unknown): { status: number; error: string; code?: string } {\n  if (error instanceof AppError) {\n    return {\n      status: error.statusCode,\n      error: error.message,\n      code: error.code,\n    };\n  }\n\n  if (error instanceof Error) {\n    console.error('Unhandled error:', error);\n    return {\n      status: 500,\n      error: 'Internal server error',\n    };\n  }\n\n  return {\n    status: 500,\n    error: 'Unknown error',\n  };\n}",

        "contents": "# V2 Backlog\n\n**DO NOT BUILD** - These features are explicitly forbidden in MVP and should only be documented for future consideration.\n\n## Forbidden Features (Per Specification)\n\n### Marketplace &amp; Discovery\n- ❌ Public marketplace/feed of vouchers\n- ❌ Deals feed\n- ❌ Ad network\n- ❌ Social platform features\n\n### Social Features\n- ❌ Comments on vouchers\n- ❌ Likes/reactions\n- ❌ Social sharing beyond native share sheet\n- ❌ User profiles/public pages\n\n### Loyalty &amp; Tiers\n- ❌ Loyalty tiers/levels\n- ❌ Points systems\n- ❌ Gamification\n\n### AI Features\n- ❌ AI-powered recommendations\n- ❌ AI-generated voucher designs\n- ❌ AI content generation\n\n### Advertising\n- ❌ Ad placements\n- ❌ Sponsored vouchers\n- ❌ Third-party advertising\n\n### Influencer Features\n- ❌ Influencer dashboards\n- ❌ Influencer-specific tools\n- ❌ Creator monetization\n\n## Potential V2 Features (Document Only)\n\nThese were mentioned in the specification as V2 backlog items:\n\n1. **Apple Wallet / Google Wallet**\n   - Add vouchers to native wallet apps\n   - QR codes in wallet format\n\n2. **Push Notifications**\n   - Credit unlock notifications\n   - Redemption confirmations\n   - Weekly drop reminders\n   - Credit expiry warnings\n\n3. **Multi-language Selector**\n   - User-selectable language (beyond browser detection)\n   - Language preferences per user\n\n4. **Custom Domains**\n   - Merchant-branded domains\n   - White-label subdomains\n\n5. **POS Deep Integrations**\n   - Direct POS system integration\n   - Real-time inventory sync\n   - Automated redemption confirmation\n\n6. **Analytics Exports**\n   - PDF reports\n   - CSV exports (already have for redemptions)\n   - Scheduled reports\n\n7. **White-label Mode**\n   - Fully branded merchant experience\n   - Remove platform branding\n   - Custom email templates\n\n## Current Non-MVP Pages (For Reference)\n\nThese pages exist but are NOT in MVP scope:\n\n- &#96;/admin&#96; - Platform admin (internal use for launch mode)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96; - Analytics dashboard (V2)",

        "contents": "/**\n * Custom error classes for better error handling\n */\n\nexport class AppError extends Error {\n  constructor(\n    message: string,\n    public statusCode: number = 500,\n    public code?: string\n  ) {\n    super(message);\n    this.name = 'AppError';\n  }\n}\n\nexport class ValidationError extends AppError {\n  constructor(message: string, public fields?: Record&lt;string, string&gt;) {\n    super(message, 400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR');\n  }\n}",

      "codeBlock": {

        "contents": "---\nname: voucher\ndescription: This is a new rule\n---\n\n# Voucher Rules\n\n## 0) SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH\n\nAinus tõde on TOTAL / ALL-IN PROMPT + MVP UI Scope-lock + Business Rules.\n\nKui miski on vastuolus → ära ehita.\n\nKüsimuse korral → küsi enne.\n\n## 1) MVP SCOPE ON LUKUS\n\nEHITADA TOHIB AINULT:\n\nVoucher → Referral → Redemption → Credit → Wallet\n\nPublic pages ilma login’ita\n\nMerchant dashboard minimaalses mahus\n\nKEELATUD MVP-S:\n\nmarketplace\n\nfeed\n\nkommentaarid / like’id\n\nloyalty tiers / badges\n\nads\n\nAI\n\ngrowth-hackid\n\nextra analytics\n\nKui funktsioon ei aita jagada, lunastada või krediteerida, siis ära ehita.\n\n## 2) TECH STACK ON LUKUS\n\nNext.js (App Router)\n\nTypeScript kõikjal\n\nPrisma + PostgreSQL\n\nshadcn/ui + Tailwind\n\nPWA (manifest + service worker)\n\nnext-intl (EN default)\n\nEi mingeid:\n\nteisi frameworke\n\ncustom CSS süsteeme\n\nteisi ORM-e\n\nparoolipõhist auth’i\n\n## 3) ROLLID &amp; ÕIGUSED (RANGE)\n\nanonymous → ainult public pages\n\nuser → ainult enda wallet &amp; vouchers\n\nmerchant_staff → redemption confirm\n\nmerchant_admin → voucherid, settings\n\nplatform_admin → audit &amp; risk\n\nReegel:\nUI võib peita, server peab alati kontrollima.\n\n## 4) PUBLIC PAGES REEGEL (KRIITILINE)\n\n/v/[voucherId] ja /r/[referralId]:\n\nEI TOHI nõuda login’it\n\nPEAVAD avanema &lt;1s\n\nPEAVAD töötama mobiilis ideaalselt\n\nJagamine peab olema 1 tap.\n\n## 5) BUSINESS RULES (MITTEVAIDLUSTATAV)\n\nCredit ≠ raha\n\nCredit on merchant-põhine\n\nCredit:\n\nalgul locked\n\navailable ainult pärast redemption confirm\n\naegub\n\nSelf-referral on keelatud\n\nWeekly Drop:\n\nlimited stock\n\nfirst-come-first-served\n\nkui otsas → otsas\n\n## 6) DATA &amp; TRANSACTIONS\n\nKõik write’id:\n\ntransaction’iga\n\nserver-side validatsioon\n\nÄra salvesta:\n\nraw phone/email (hash ainult)\n\nPrisma schema = püha\n\nÄra kasuta JSON-i, kui on vaja relatsiooni (v.a designJson, conditionsJson).\n\n## 7) UI &amp; UX REEGLID\n\n1 primary CTA per vaade\n\nMobile-first (desktop = enhancement)\n\nEi mingeid “wizard’eid” üle 2 sammu\n\nEi mingeid modal-hell’e\n\nCredit peab tunduma päris väärtusena",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp; vouchers\n\n### MVP UI Scope\n**PUBLIC:**\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page\n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n**USER:**\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo\n\n**MERCHANT:**\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n**Non-MVP (Documented):**\n- &#96;/admin&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;         "contents": "# Changelog\n\n## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-XX\n\n### Added\n- Multi-tenant voucher platform with merchant isolation\n- Voucher creation, publishing, and management\n- Referral system with shareable links\n- Credit system (locked/unlocked states)\n- Weekly drop functionality with stock management\n- PWA support with service worker and offline QR codes\n- RBAC (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- Fraud prevention (rate limiting, self-referral prevention)\n- Email magic link authentication\n- Google and Apple OAuth support\n- Merchant dashboard\n- User wallet and credit management\n- Checkout demo for credit application\n- API documentation\n- Unit tests for credit system\n- Seed data script\n- Docker compose setup for local development\n\n### Technical\n- Next.js 14 with App Router\n- TypeScript strict mode\n- Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL\n- TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui components\n- NextAuth for authentication\n- Zod for validation\n- Vitest for testing\n- i18n structure (next-intl, ready for expansion)\n\n## [1.1.0] - 2024-01-XX (Planned)\n\n### Added\n- Voucher publish endpoint\n- Voucher update endpoint\n- Better error handling with custom error classes\n- Type definitions\n- Session provider for client components\n- Validation utilities\n\n### Fixed\n- Missing publish functionality\n- TypeScript type safety improvements",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Changelog",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-XX",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "### Added",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "- Multi-tenant voucher platform with merchant isolation",
            "lineNumber": 6

        "contents": "&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Weekly Drop\n\n#### Claim Weekly Drop\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;http\nPOST /api/weekly-drop/claim\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Auth**: Required\n\n**Body**:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"voucherId\": \"clx...\",\n  \"friendHint\": \"friend@example.com\"  // optional\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Response**:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"referralId\": \"clx...\",\n  \"shareUrl\": \"https://app.com/r/clx...\",\n  \"remaining\": 19\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 233
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 234
          },
          {
            "text": "### Weekly Drop",
            "lineNumber": 235
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 236
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Claim Weekly Drop",
            "lineNumber": 237
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 238
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;http",
            "lineNumber": 239
          },
          {
            "text": "POST /api/weekly-drop/claim",
            "lineNumber": 240
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",

        "contents": "# Launch Mode Configuration\n\nPer specification section 15, the platform is prepared for **invite-only merchants** with **manual onboarding**.\n\n## Current Implementation\n\n### Platform Admin\n- **Route**: &#96;/admin&#96;\n- **Access**: Environment variable &#96;PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS&#96;\n- **Purpose**: Manual merchant onboarding and monitoring\n- **Status**: Minimal implementation (ready for expansion)\n\n### Merchant Member Management\n- **Route**: &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;\n- **Access**: Merchant admin only\n- **Purpose**: Add/remove merchant staff\n- **Status**: Basic UI (add via database/API for now)\n\n## Feature Flags (To Implement)\n\nThe specification requires:\n- Feature flags per merchant\n- Kill switch per merchant\n- Invite-only merchant signup\n\n### Recommended Implementation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Add to Merchant model\nmodel Merchant {\n  // ... existing fields\n  isActive      Boolean @default(true)  // Kill switch\n  featureFlags  Json?                   // Per-merchant feature flags\n  invitedAt    DateTime?                // Track manual invites\n  onboardedAt  DateTime?                // Track onboarding completion\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Feature Flag Examples\n- &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;customDomainsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;analyticsEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n- &#96;whiteLabelEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n\n## Manual Onboarding Flow\n\n1. **Platform admin** creates merchant via database/API\n2. **Platform admin** adds merchant admin user via &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; or database\n3. **Merchant admin** receives invite email (to implement)\n4. **Merchant admin** logs in and completes onboarding\n5. **Merchant** can start creating vouchers\n\n## Kill Switch\n\nTo disable a merchant:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis should:\n- Hide merchant from public routes\n- Prevent new voucher creation\n- Allow existing redemptions to complete\n- Log action in AuditLog\n\n## No Public Signup\n\n- ✅ No public merchant signup form\n- ✅ No public user registration (except via OAuth/magic link)",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { hashFriendIdentifier } from '@/lib/utils';\nimport { checkReferralRateLimit } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createReferralSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  friendHint: z.string().optional(), // optional identifier hint for friend\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const { voucherId, friendHint } = createReferralSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not available' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check rate limit\n    const rateLimit = await checkReferralRateLimit(session.user.id);\n    if (!rateLimit.allowed) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: rateLimit.remaining },\n        { status: 429 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Hash friend identifier if provided\n    const friendHash = friendHint\n      ? await hashFriendIdentifier(friendHint)\n      : &#96;anonymous_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}&#96;;\n\n    // Create referral\n    const referral = await prisma.referral.create({\n      data: {\n        voucherId: voucher.id,\n        merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n        referrerUserId: session.user.id,\n        friendHash,\n        status: 'created',\n      },\n    });\n\n    // Generate share URL\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${referral.id}&#96;;\n\n    return NextResponse.json\n\n}",

UI/UX parandused\n\n### 6.1 Loading states\n\n**Probleem:** Mõned komponendid ei näita loading state'i\n\n**Asukohad:**\n- &#96;app/admin/merchants-table.tsx&#96; - fetchMerchants\n- &#96;app/admin/audit-log-view.tsx&#96; - fetchLogs\n\n**Lahendus:**\n- Loading state'id on juba olemas, aga võivad vajada täiendamist\n\n### 6.2 Error messages\n\n**Probleem:** Mõned error message'id ei ole kasutajasõbralikud\n\n**Lahendus:**\n- Kasuta i18n translation'e error message'ide jaoks\n- Lisa retry nupud, kus võimalik\n\n## 7. Testimine\n\n### 7.1 Unit testid\n\n**Probleem:** Uued funktsioonid ei ole testitud\n\n**Lahendus:**\n- Lisa testid voucher edit'ile\n- Lisa testid member invite'ile\n- Lisa testid platform admin funktsioonidele\n\n### 7.2 Integration testid\n\n**Probleem:** E2E testid vajavad täiendamist\n\n**Lahendus:**\n- Täienda E2E teste uute funktsioonidega\n- Lisa testid voucher search'ile\n\n## Prioriteedid\n\n### Kõrge prioriteet (enne production'i)\n1. TypeScript type safety - &#96;any&#96; tüüpide asendamine\n2. Error tracking - &#96;console.error&#96; asendamine\n3. Validation täiendused - voucher edit, member invite\n\n### Keskmine prioriteet\n4. Type definitions - FeatureFlags, AuditLog payload\n5. Production readiness - console.log eemaldamine\n6. Error messages - kasutajasõbralikumad\n\n### Madal prioriteet\n7. UI/UX parandused - loading states, error messages\n8. Testimine - unit ja integration testid\n\n## Järgmised sammud\n\n1. **Type safety:** Asenda &#96;any&#96; tüübid konkreetsete tüüpidega\n2. **Error tracking:** Integreeri error tracking kõikidesse error handler'itesse\n3. **Validation:** Täienda validation'i uutes funktsioonides\n4. **Testing:** Lisa testid uutele funktsioonidele\n5. **Documentation:** Uuenda dokumentatsiooni, kui vaja\n\n## Märkused\n\n- Need parandused on peamiselt koodi kvaliteedi ja tootmisvalmiduse parandused\n- MVP funktsionaalsus on valmis\n- Parandused ei muuda business logic'i, vaid parandavad koodi kvaliteeti\n- Kõik parandused on backward compatible",

Kõik todo-d on tehtud. Kokkuvõte:

## Lõpetatud parandused

### 1. TypeScript type safety
- Lisatud `FeatureFlags` interface `types/index.ts`'is
- Lisatud `AuditLogPayload` interface
- Asendatud `any` tüübid konkreetsete tüüpidega:
  - `designJson` → `VoucherDesign`
  - `weeklyDropJson` → `WeeklyDropConfig`
  - `featureFlags` → `FeatureFlags`
  - `payloadJson` → `AuditLogPayload`
- Parandatud error handling tüübid (`error: any` → `error: unknown`)

### 2. Error tracking
- Asendatud `console.error` kutsed `captureException` kutsetega:
  - API route'id: vouchers, redemptions, referrals, members, admin endpoints
  - Client komponendid: admin tables, audit log view
  - Stripe webhook error handling
- Lisatud context info error tracking'ule (userId, merchantId, jne)

### 3. Validation täiendused
- Voucher edit vorm:
  - validFrom < validTo kontroll
  - value > 0 kontroll
  - usage limits positiivsed
- Member invite: parandatud error message'id
- Platform admin: feature flags validation (Zod schema)

### 4. Production readiness
- Asendatud `console.log` conditional logging'uga (ainult development'is)
- Parandatud error message'id, et need oleksid kasutajasõbralikumad
- Production error message'id on generic'ud (ei leki süsteemi infot)

## Kokkuvõte

Kõik kõrge prioriteediga parandused on tehtud:
- Type safety parandatud
- Error tracking integreeritud
- Validation täiendatud
- Production logging parandatud
- Error message'id kasutajasõbralikumad

Projekt on nüüd valmis production'iks, kui on tehtud production setup (environment variables, database migrations, jne).
